detail.title: Current Evidence on Household Financial Well-Being

publicationDetails.detailsText: Aspen Economic Strategy Group Policy Paper Series No. 3
publicationDetails.journalName: Aspen Economic Strategy Group Policy Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite strong economic conditions, survey data reveal substantial economic worry and discontent among Americans. Pew survey data from 2024 indicated that “strengthening the economy” was Americans’ top policy priority, above “defending against terrorism,” “reducing crime,” and “dealing with immigration” (Pew 2024). A separate Pew survey from that same year found that only 53 percent of Americans believe that the “American Dream,” defined as the idea that anyone can achieve success in the United States through hard work and determination, is still possible (Borelli 2024). Advancing broad economic prosperity requires an understanding of the economic well-being of American households, as well as potential contributors to widespread economic malaise. With that goal, this piece highlights current evidence on household financial well-being through six facts and accompanying figures. First, we document trends in earnings and income growth across the wage distribution as well as by educational attainment, gender, and geography. Second, we highlight trends in the costs of two salient household budget items: housing and healthcare.

AI.tldr: 本文通过六个事实和数据图表分析美国家庭财务福祉现状，揭示尽管经济状况良好，但美国人普遍存在经济担忧和不满的原因。
AI.research_question: 为什么在强劲的经济条件下，美国人仍然存在普遍的经济担忧和不满？美国家庭财务福祉的现状如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管经济指标良好，但调查显示美国人普遍存在经济担忧，只有53%的人相信"美国梦"仍然可能实现。理解美国家庭经济福祉现状对于推动广泛经济繁荣至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济福祉理论，关注收入分配、生活成本压力与主观经济感受之间的差距。强调客观经济指标与主观感知之间的脱节。
AI.method: 通过六个事实和相应图表分析美国家庭财务福祉：1) 工资分布、教育程度、性别和地理区域的收入增长趋势；2) 住房和医疗保健两大关键家庭预算项目的成本趋势。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 收入增长在不同群体间存在显著差异；2) 住房和医疗保健成本上升对家庭预算造成压力；3) 客观经济指标与主观经济感受之间存在明显脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：揭示了经济福祉评估中客观指标与主观感知的脱节现象，为理解经济繁荣感知与实际情况之间的差距提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为政策制定者提供了美国家庭财务福祉的详细现状分析，有助于制定更有针对性的经济政策，解决民众实际关切的经济问题。

reference: Forthcoming in the Journal of Law, Economics & Policy
title: The Big Two Go Global: The Expansion of BlackRock and Vanguard in Brazil

detail.title: The Big Two Go Global: The Expansion of BlackRock and Vanguard in Brazil

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in the Journal of Law, Economics & Policy

detail.abstract: This Article sheds light on the rise of BlackRock and Vanguard as major institutional investors in Brazil. Over recent decades, the American “Big Two” asset managers have become the world’s largest, extending their reach into international markets. Yet their presence outside the United States remains underexplored, limiting a deeper understanding of their economic influence and their role in driving global trends toward ownership concentration and common ownership. This Article helps fill that gap by tracing their expansion into Brazil’s public equity market. Drawing on S&P Capital IQ data, it shows that BlackRock and Vanguard increased their combined share of the market capitalization of 191 B3-listed companies by 7.6 percentage points between 2008 and 2023, reaching 9.6%. Their investments were especially pronounced in the materials, IT, and energy sectors. By 2023, the Big Two held ownership stakes of 5% or more in nearly half of the sample, and in seven companies BlackRock alone held more than 10%, emerging as the largest shareholder in two. In doing so, this study provides the first systematic account of the Big Two’s footprint in Brazil and highlights key policy concerns for further investigation regarding their rise in markets dominated by controlling shareholders.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地追踪了美国"两大"资产管理公司（黑石和先锋）在巴西股市的扩张，发现2008-2023年间它们在巴西上市公司市值份额从2%增至9.6%，在近半数样本公司持股超5%，引发了在控股股东主导市场中所有权集中和共同所有权的政策担忧。
AI.research_question: 黑石和先锋这两大美国资产管理公司在巴西股市的扩张程度如何？它们对巴西上市公司所有权结构产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 黑石和先锋已成为全球最大资产管理公司，但其在美国以外市场的影响力研究不足，限制了对其经济影响和推动全球所有权集中趋势的理解。巴西作为新兴市场，其控股股东主导的市场结构为研究提供了独特背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机构投资者理论、所有权集中理论、共同所有权理论、跨国资本流动理论、新兴市场公司治理理论
AI.method: 使用S&P Capital IQ数据，分析191家B3上市公司2008-2023年的股权结构变化，追踪黑石和先锋的市场份额增长、行业分布和持股比例
AI.findings: 1) 黑石和先锋在巴西上市公司市值份额从2008年的2%增至2023年的9.6%；2) 投资集中在材料、IT和能源行业；3) 2023年，在近半数样本公司持股超5%；4) 黑石在7家公司持股超10%，成为其中2家最大股东
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统描绘了"两大"资产管理公司在巴西市场的扩张轨迹，为理解跨国机构投资者在新兴市场的作用提供了实证基础，丰富了所有权集中和共同所有权理论在新兴市场背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了关于外资机构投资者在巴西市场影响力的量化证据，揭示了在控股股东主导的市场中所有权结构变化带来的政策挑战，为投资者关系管理和公司治理实践提供了参考

title: Default Risk and Liquidity Provision of Sovereign Debt
affiliations: and Kent State University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Default Risk and Liquidity Provision of Sovereign Debt
detail.abstract: Sovereign bonds are widely used as collateral to support credit transactions, and the haircuts—discounts on asset values when pledged as collateral—are closely linked to sovereign default risk. We extend a standard model of sovereign default by incorporating the liquidity role of sovereign bonds as collateral and study the implications of this liquidity channel for default risk and interest rates. Taking the government's default decision as given, we show that a rise in default probability increases the haircut on sovereign bonds, reducing their liquidity premium. However, this effect is mitigated by a general equilibrium effect whereby a reduction in the effective stock of collateral raises liquidity premia for both risk-free assets and risky sovereign bonds. We also endogenize the government's default decision and show that the liquidity role of sovereign bonds reduces the government’s incentive to default by generating an endogenous cost of default.

AI.tldr: 该研究扩展了主权违约模型，纳入主权债券作为抵押品的流动性作用，分析了流动性渠道对违约风险和利率的影响。研究发现，违约概率上升会增加主权债券的折价率，降低其流动性溢价，但这一效应会被一般均衡效应所缓解。同时，主权债券的流动性角色通过产生内生违约成本，降低了政府的违约动机。
AI.research_question: 主权债券作为抵押品的流动性角色如何影响主权违约风险和利率？
AI.motivation: 主权债券在信贷交易中被广泛用作抵押品，其折价率（作为抵押品时的价值折扣）与主权违约风险密切相关。现有标准主权违约模型未充分考虑主权债券的流动性角色，需要研究这一流动性渠道对违约风险和利率的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的标准主权违约模型，纳入主权债券作为抵押品的流动性角色，分析流动性溢价、折价率与违约风险之间的相互作用机制。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，首先在给定政府违约决策下分析流动性渠道效应，然后内生化政府违约决策，考察流动性角色对违约激励的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 违约概率上升会增加主权债券的折价率，降低其流动性溢价；2. 这一效应被一般均衡效应缓解：抵押品有效存量减少会同时提高无风险资产和风险主权债券的流动性溢价；3. 主权债券的流动性角色通过产生内生违约成本，降低了政府的违约动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将主权债券的流动性角色纳入标准主权违约模型；2. 揭示了流动性渠道对违约风险和利率的影响机制；3. 提出了内生违约成本的概念，解释了流动性如何影响政府违约决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解主权债券市场中的风险定价提供了新视角；2. 有助于政策制定者评估流动性因素对主权债务可持续性的影响；3. 为金融机构管理抵押品风险提供了理论依据。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3211
title: Severe Weather and Financial (In)stability
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, University of Perugia and Bocconi University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Severe Weather and Financial (In)stability

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We quantify the effect of severe weather shocks on the US economy in an environment in which the economy can switch between periods of financial stability and financial instability, like the Great Recession. We estimate a New Keynesian dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with banks and severe weather events. We show that severe weather shocks: 1) have a negative impact on real and financial US variables, sizable only in periods of financial instability, but muted effects on nominal variables; 2) are never a relevant source of business cycles fluctuations; 3) transmit mainly via a deterioration in the quality of capital.

AI.tldr: 本文量化了严重天气冲击对美国经济的影响，发现在金融不稳定时期（如大衰退）这些冲击对实体和金融变量有显著负面影响，但对名义变量影响微弱，且从来不是商业周期波动的主要来源。
AI.research_question: 严重天气冲击在美国经济中（特别是在金融稳定与不稳定时期切换的环境中）对实体经济、金融变量和商业周期波动有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，极端天气事件频发，需要理解这些冲击对经济的影响机制，特别是在不同金融环境下的差异化效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义动态随机一般均衡模型（DSGE），包含银行部门和严重天气冲击。
AI.method: 构建并估计包含银行部门和严重天气冲击的新凯恩斯DSGE模型，模拟分析在不同金融状态（稳定vs不稳定）下的冲击传导机制。
AI.findings: 1) 严重天气冲击对实体和金融变量有负面影响，但仅在金融不稳定时期显著，对名义变量影响微弱；2) 这些冲击从来不是商业周期波动的主要来源；3) 传导机制主要通过资本质量恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将天气冲击纳入DSGE框架，揭示了金融状态在天气冲击传导中的调节作用，拓展了气候经济学与金融经济学的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：在金融不稳定时期需要特别关注天气冲击的放大效应，同时强调天气冲击不是商业周期的主要驱动因素，有助于合理配置政策资源。

title: In Its Right Mind: Governance of Social Superintelligence
affiliations: Independent, University of California, Irvine and University of Kansas School of Law

detail.title: In Its Right Mind: Governance of Social Superintelligence

detail.abstract: The emergence of social superintelligence will profoundly challenge existing legal frameworks and societal norms. This Article provides a comprehensive snapshot of the field’s current state, and concludes with a set of legal questions that arise from broad deployment of current and near-term future social intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了社会超级智能的出现对现有法律框架和社会规范的挑战，提供了该领域现状的全面概览，并提出了当前和近期社会智能广泛部署引发的法律问题。
AI.research_question: 社会超级智能的出现将如何挑战现有法律框架和社会规范？当前和近期社会智能的广泛部署会引发哪些关键法律问题？
AI.motivation: 随着社会超级智能技术的快速发展，现有法律体系和社会规范面临前所未有的挑战，需要前瞻性地识别和应对这些新兴问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与社会规范理论、人工智能治理理论、技术与社会互动理论、监管框架理论
AI.method: 文献综述与现状分析、法律问题识别、理论框架构建
AI.findings: 社会超级智能将深刻挑战现有法律体系，需要重新思考责任归属、权利界定、监管框架等核心法律问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了社会超级智能法律挑战的理论分析框架，为未来法律体系适应智能社会发展提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了社会智能部署中的具体法律问题，为政策制定者、法律从业者和技术开发者提供了实践指导。

reference: ECB Occasional Paper No. 2026/384
title: Global Implications of Export Controls on Rare Earths: A Model-Based Assessment
affiliations: , , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: Global Implications of Export Controls on Rare Earths: A Model-Based Assessment

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Occasional Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: In April and in October 2025 China imposed export controls on rare earths amid escalating trade tensions with the United States. Although these measures were too short-lived to generate macroeconomic effects, they signalled China’s ability to draw on its dominant position in the rare earth supply chain. This paper provides a structured assessment of the potential macroeconomic consequences associated with rare earth supply disruptions. First, it documents that exposure to rare earth supply disruptions is concentrated in high-tech and security-sensitive sectors including automotive, electronics and defence-related industries. Second, drawing on earlier episodes of Chinese export restrictions on critical minerals (notably in 2010 and 2023), it highlights two key mitigating forces from the targeted countries’ perspective: practical and strategic constraints on China’s ability to implement strict export bans, and innovation-led substitution by targeted countries. Third, the paper quantifies the global macroeconomic implications of a hypothetical scenario of stringent but partial Chinese export restrictions on rare earths lasting for 18 months. To do so, the analysis combines, for the various segments of the transmission chain, a partial equilibrium setup, a closed-economy DSGE model, and the multi-country multi-sector dynamic model of Aguilar et al. (2026). The main results, across specifications, suggest estimated output losses for the United States ranging between 0.3% and 0.6%, with the largest impacts concentrated in automotive and electronics manufacturing. The results at the same time highlight the sensitivity of model-based estimates to assumptions on the substitutability of rare earths and the severity of restrictions.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了中国稀土出口管制对全球经济的潜在影响，发现美国可能面临0.3%-0.6%的产出损失，影响主要集中在汽车和电子制造业。
AI.research_question: 中国稀土出口管制对全球宏观经济会产生怎样的影响？特别是对高科技和安全敏感行业的影响程度如何？
AI.motivation: 2025年中国对稀土实施出口管制，虽然时间短暂但显示了中国在稀土供应链中的主导地位。需要系统评估稀土供应中断对全球经济的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合部分均衡分析、封闭经济DSGE模型以及Aguilar等人的多国多部门动态模型，构建综合评估框架。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1）分析稀土供应中断的行业集中度；2）基于历史案例（2010年和2023年）分析缓解因素；3）使用多种模型量化18个月严格但部分出口限制的宏观经济影响。
AI.findings: 1）稀土供应中断风险集中在汽车、电子和国防等高科技和安全敏感行业；2）中国实施严格出口禁令存在实际和战略约束，目标国会通过创新替代来缓解；3）美国产出损失估计在0.3%-0.6%之间，影响最大的行业是汽车和电子制造。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了综合评估稀土供应中断宏观经济影响的框架，结合了微观行业分析和宏观动态模型，为资源贸易政策分析提供了方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了稀土供应中断风险的具体量化评估，帮助识别最脆弱行业，为供应链多元化战略和应急计划提供依据，同时强调了替代技术创新的重要性。

title: Point-wise Convergence to the Expected Equilibrium Price in Stochastic Online Fisher Markets: A Human-AI Collaborative Study
affiliations: Nanjing University - School of Management and Engineering, Nanjing University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Independent

detail.title: Point-wise Convergence to the Expected Equilibrium Price in Stochastic Online Fisher Markets: A Human-AI Collaborative Study
detail.abstract: In scenarios such as cloud computing and digital advertising, a platform sequentially prices and allocates resources to arriving users with stochastic budgets and utilities. We model this problem as a stochastic online Fisher market. While the expected equilibrium price p* provides a natural benchmark, the necessity and guarantees of an online pricing policy's point-wise convergence to p* remain underexplored. We study this necessity through a human-AI collaboration paradigm, in which AI generates candidate ideas and the authors formalize the rigorous analysis. This yields an algorithm-independent mathematical framework bounding the expected regret and market-clearing deviation of any online pricing policy by its cumulative point-wise deviation from p*, making point-wise convergence key to performance guarantees. Motivated by this, we analyze two data-driven pricing methods: Sample Average Approximation (SAA) and first-order methods. Assuming structural conditions and bounded iterates, the SAA iterate based on n observations converges to p* at rate O(n^{-1/2}), up to logarithmic factors, while the first-order iterate achieves O(t^{-1/2}) at step $t$. The structural conditions that define well-conditioned markets are satisfied by CES and Cobb-Douglas utilities, and economically reflect expected demand sensitivity and stability. Numerical experiments validate our results, together providing a foundation for stable and efficient platform operations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了随机在线Fisher市场中定价策略的点态收敛必要性，提出了基于人机协作的分析框架，证明了点态收敛对性能保证的关键作用，并分析了SAA和一阶方法在满足结构条件下的收敛速率。
AI.research_question: 在线定价策略点态收敛到均衡价格的必要性是什么？在什么条件下数据驱动的定价方法能够实现点态收敛？
AI.motivation: 在云计算和数字广告等场景中，平台需要为具有随机预算和效用的用户顺序定价和分配资源。虽然期望均衡价格提供了自然基准，但在线定价策略点态收敛到均衡价格的必要性和保证尚未得到充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机在线Fisher市场模型，均衡价格理论，点态收敛分析框架，人机协作范式（AI生成候选想法，作者进行形式化分析）。
AI.method: 算法独立的数学框架，通过累积点态偏差界定期望遗憾和市场清算偏差；分析两种数据驱动定价方法：样本平均近似法（SAA）和一阶方法；在结构条件和有界迭代假设下进行收敛性分析。
AI.findings: 1）点态收敛是性能保证的关键；2）基于n个观测的SAA迭代以O(n^{-1/2})速率收敛到均衡价格（对数因子内）；3）一阶方法在步骤t以O(t^{-1/2})速率收敛；4）结构条件（定义良好条件市场）由CES和Cobb-Douglas效用函数满足，反映了预期需求敏感性和稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了点态收敛必要性的理论框架；2）证明了点态收敛与性能保证的数学关系；3）为数据驱动定价方法提供了收敛性理论保证；4）识别了良好条件市场的结构特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为平台运营提供了稳定高效的定价策略理论基础；2）指导实际应用中定价算法的选择和设计；3）通过数值实验验证了理论结果的实际可行性；4）为云计算、数字广告等领域的资源分配问题提供了解决方案。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3212
title: Assessing the Impact of the EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility on Institutional Quality: a Bayesian Synthetic Control Approach
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Assessing the Impact of the EU’s Recovery and Resilience Facility on Institutional Quality: a Bayesian Synthetic Control Approach

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), launched in 2021, aims to promote long-term economic growth in EU Member States by incentivising structural reforms and investments. This paper explores a related supply-side transmission mechanism: improvements in institutional quality, as measured by the Worldwide Governance Indicators. Using a Bayesian synthetic control model and data up to 2024, we find robust and economically meaningful RRF-induced improvements in institutional quality in Italy. For other main RRF beneficiary countries, the evidence of such an effect ranges from suggestive to limited. We show that this cross-country variation is broadly consistent with the implementation of the national Recovery and Resilience Plans in terms of implementation speed and reform mix. While it is too early to draw firm policy conclusions, the findings lend support to the view that conditional, reform-linked financing instruments of the RRF type can improve institutional quality and, thereby, long-term growth prospects – provided that the reforms are well designed and effectively implemented.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用贝叶斯合成控制模型分析欧盟复苏与韧性基金（RRF）对成员国制度质量的影响，发现意大利的制度质量有显著改善，其他主要受益国的效果则从暗示性到有限不等，表明RRF类型的改革关联融资工具在改革设计良好且有效实施时能改善制度质量和长期增长前景。
AI.research_question: 欧盟复苏与韧性基金（RRF）是否以及如何通过改善制度质量来促进成员国的长期经济增长？
AI.motivation: RRF作为欧盟2021年启动的重要经济刺激计划，旨在通过激励结构性改革和投资促进长期经济增长，但其对制度质量的影响机制尚不明确，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学理论，强调制度质量对经济增长的重要性；运用供给侧传导机制理论，分析RRF通过改善制度质量促进经济增长的路径。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯合成控制模型，使用截至2024年的数据，以世界治理指标衡量制度质量，分析RRF对主要受益国制度质量的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 意大利的制度质量在RRF实施后出现稳健且经济意义显著的改善；2. 其他主要RRF受益国的效果从暗示性到有限不等；3. 跨国差异与各国复苏与韧性计划的实施速度和改革组合基本一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为RRF的供给侧传导机制提供了实证证据；2. 丰富了制度质量与经济增长关系的实证研究；3. 展示了改革关联融资工具对制度改善的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 支持RRF类型的条件性融资工具在改善制度质量方面的有效性；2. 强调改革设计和实施质量的重要性；3. 为欧盟及其他地区类似政策设计提供参考。

reference: Alexandra Allen-Franks, 'Delineating "Context of Use" for the Purposes of Trade Mark Infringement' [2026] IPQ 1
title: Delineating "Context of Use" for the Purposes of Trade Mark Infringement
affiliations: University of Auckland - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Delineating "Context of Use" for the Purposes of Trade Mark Infringement

publicationDetails.detailsText: Alexandra Allen-Franks, 'Delineating "Context of Use" for the Purposes of Trade Mark Infringement' [2026] IPQ 1

detail.abstract: The proposition that a judge should make a contextual assessment of the use of a defendant's sign for the purposes of assessing a likelihood of confusion for trade mark infringement under s.10(2) of the Trade Marks Act 1994 seems simple enough. However, as currently applied, "context" is a concept of potentially great breadth. This has negative consequences for proportionate justice. This discussion proposes therefore that the context of use of a defendant's sign should be conceptualised as including only those things close enough to the core of the defendant's sign to be consistently present with the sign and assumed to always be seen by the average consumer (an "irreducible core").

AI.tldr: 本文主张在商标侵权混淆可能性评估中，应将被告标志的使用"语境"概念化为仅包括那些与被告标志核心足够接近、始终伴随标志存在且被普通消费者始终看到的内容（"不可约核心"），以解决当前语境概念过于宽泛导致比例正义受损的问题。
AI.research_question: 在商标侵权混淆可能性评估中，如何正确定义和限制"被告标志使用语境"的概念，以确保比例正义？
AI.motivation: 当前商标侵权案件中，法官对被告标志使用语境的评估概念过于宽泛，这损害了比例正义原则，需要更精确的界定标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于英国《1994年商标法》第10(2)条的混淆可能性评估框架，结合比例正义理论和消费者认知理论，提出"不可约核心"概念。
AI.method: 采用法律分析和理论论证的方法，通过对现有判例法的批判性分析，提出概念重构建议。
AI.findings: 当前语境概念的过度宽泛应用导致司法不公，应将语境限定为与被告标志核心紧密相关、始终伴随且被普通消费者必然感知的"不可约核心"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"不可约核心"这一新的法律概念，为商标侵权中的语境评估提供了更精确的理论框架，丰富了比例正义在知识产权法中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法官在商标侵权案件中评估混淆可能性提供了更明确的操作指南，有助于实现更公正、可预测的司法判决，平衡商标权人与被告的利益。

reference: Kansas Law Review, Volume 75
title: Proportionate NIL Paradigms
affiliations: Northern Kentucky University

detail.title: Proportionate NIL Paradigms
detail.abstract: Gender equality is the prerequisite for a fair and just society. To this end, Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972 ("Title IX") seeks to end sex discrimination in educational settings and, ultimately, society as a whole. Yet despite storied progress in higher education, women still experience unequal treatment. Recently, this has become more noticeable in intercollegiate athletics, where name, image, and likeness compensation (NIL) for male athletes exponentially outpaces that of female athletes. This persistent reality has produced national uncertainty over the applicability of Title IX to NIL generally, and to the multibillion-dollar House v. NCAA settlement specifically. The U.S. Department of Education sought to resolve this uncertainty by issuing guidance that categorized NIL as "financial assistance" subject to Title IX's proportionality requirement. However, the new administration rescinded the guidance less than a month later. This Article examines the effect of the rescission on Title IX's promise of gender equality in educational settings. It concludes that the rescission does not alter Title IX's reach. Rather, it defers resolution of the issue to other authorities. Because Title IX applies to the activities of educational institutions, the operative question for these authorities is not whether Title IX's promise of equality applies to NIL provided by colleges and universities, but rather, how it applies. This Article argues that although Congressional authority would be ideal, ultimately, the responsibility will fall on the courts. Lastly, given the lack of statutory direction regarding NIL, this Article evaluates prevailing approaches to statutory interpretation and proposes that courts adopt the approach that best harmonizes Title IX's text, purpose and legislative intent.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国教育部撤销NIL（姓名、形象和肖像权）补偿作为Title IX"经济援助"分类的指导文件后，对Title IX在教育环境中实现性别平等承诺的影响，认为撤销并未改变Title IX的适用范围，而是将问题推给其他机构解决。
AI.research_question: 教育部撤销将NIL补偿归类为Title IX"经济援助"的指导文件，对Title IX在教育环境中实现性别平等的承诺有何影响？
AI.motivation: 尽管Title IX旨在消除教育环境中的性别歧视，但在大学体育领域，男性运动员的NIL补偿远远超过女性运动员，这种不平等现象日益突出。教育部发布指导文件后又迅速撤销，造成了法律适用上的不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Title IX法律框架、性别平等理论、法律解释理论（文本主义、目的主义、立法意图主义）
AI.method: 法律分析、政策分析、案例研究、法律解释方法比较
AI.findings: 撤销指导文件并未改变Title IX对NIL补偿的适用性，只是将问题的解决推迟给其他机构。Title IX适用于教育机构的活动，关键问题不是是否适用，而是如何适用。最终责任将落在法院身上。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了Title IX法律框架在NIL补偿问题上的适用性，提出了法律解释方法的整合框架，为理解行政指导文件撤销对法律原则的影响提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、教育机构和法院提供了处理NIL补偿性别平等问题的具体建议，强调了国会立法和法院解释在解决这一问题上的重要性，提出了协调法律文本、目的和立法意图的解释方法。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3213
title: The Third-Country Effects of Trade Wars
affiliations: , University of Lausanne and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: The Third-Country Effects of Trade Wars

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study how trade wars propagate to countries that are not directly targeted. We develop a three-country New Keynesian model with trade in final and intermediate goods, incomplete asset markets, and asymmetric monetary regimes, and quantify the spillovers of the 2025 U.S.-China tariff escalation to the euro area. A bilateral U.S.-China trade war generates large and asymmetric welfare losses for the U.S. and China, while the euro area benefits temporarily from trade diversion. Once tariffs extend to euro-area goods, third-country welfare flips into losses and the Chinese downturn deepens. Welfare-maximizing retaliatory tariffs by the euro area deliver only modest domestic improvements, at the cost of large additional losses for the U.S. and China. Overall, the global incidence of trade policy is intrinsically multilateral: third-country gains under bilateral protectionism are short-lived, reverse once protection broadens, and cannot be inferred from two-country analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究贸易战如何传播到非直接目标国家。通过三国家新凯恩斯模型分析2025年美中关税升级对欧元区的溢出效应，发现双边贸易战使美中遭受重大福利损失，欧元区暂时受益；但当关税扩展到欧元区商品时，第三方国家福利转为损失，中国衰退加深。欧元区报复性关税只能带来有限的国内改善，却给美中造成巨大额外损失。
AI.research_question: 贸易战如何传播到非直接目标国家？特别是美中双边贸易战对欧元区等第三方国家的溢出效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有贸易战研究多关注双边效应，缺乏对第三方国家溢出效应的系统性分析。现实中贸易政策具有多边性质，需要理解贸易战如何通过全球价值链传播到非直接目标国家。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三国家新凯恩斯模型，包含最终产品和中间品贸易、不完全资产市场、不对称货币政策体制
AI.method: 构建理论模型并进行量化分析，模拟2025年美中关税升级情景，评估对欧元区的溢出效应
AI.findings:
1. 美中双边贸易战导致两国重大福利损失，欧元区因贸易转移暂时受益
2. 当关税扩展到欧元区商品时，第三方国家福利转为损失，中国衰退加深
3. 欧元区报复性关税只能带来有限的国内改善，却给美中造成巨大额外损失
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 证明贸易政策的全球影响本质上是多边的
2. 双边保护主义下的第三方国家收益是短暂的，一旦保护范围扩大就会逆转
3. 无法从两国分析中推断第三方国家效应
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供贸易战多边影响的量化评估
2. 警示第三方国家在贸易战中的脆弱性
3. 表明报复性关税的有限收益和高昂全球成本

title: Transformer Uncertainty and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: Transformer Uncertainty and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
detail.abstract: We introduce W_Trans , a measure of model uncertainty extracted from the prediction interval width of a Feature Tokenizer Transformer trained on 35 economic-theme principal components derived from 212 anomaly signals. W Trans has zero unconditional return predictability (t ≈ 0.5) across all smoothing horizons and subperiods. However, the interaction of W Trans with the anomaly consensus signal µ generates Fama-MacBeth t-statistics exceeding 8 and a difference-indifferences portfolio alpha of +1.29% per month under Fama-French five-factor adjustment, with the sign-flip breakeven near the sample median of µ. The conditional signal survives microcap exclusion (t = 5.94), value weighting (t = 2.58), double-clustered standard errors (t = 6.18), a kitchensink specification with 35 theme controls (t = 5.74), and firm fixed-effect absorption (t = 2.37); a competing µ × σ interaction washes out completely (t =-0.19). The premium concentrates in low-attention stocks-low media coverage (t = 3.69) and low analyst following (t = 7.74)-and is absent among high-attention stocks (t < 1), consistent with a limits-to-arbitrage mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出W_Trans作为模型不确定性度量，基于特征标记器转换器对35个经济主题主成分的预测区间宽度。研究发现W_Trans本身无无条件收益预测能力，但与异常共识信号μ交互时产生显著超额收益，且该效应在低关注度股票中尤为明显。
AI.research_question: 模型不确定性度量W_Trans与异常共识信号μ的交互作用如何影响股票收益预测？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注单一不确定性度量，但模型不确定性如何与市场共识信号交互影响资产定价尚不清楚，特别是在不同关注度股票中的差异化表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论、模型不确定性概念、预测区间理论、有限套利理论，探讨不确定性-共识交互效应。
AI.method: 使用特征标记器转换器从212个异常信号中提取35个经济主题主成分，构建W_Trans度量；采用Fama-MacBeth回归、双重差分组合分析、多种稳健性检验（剔除微盘股、价值加权、双重聚类标准误、35个主题控制、公司固定效应吸收）。
AI.findings: 1) W_Trans本身无无条件预测能力；2) W_Trans×μ交互产生显著正超额收益（月alpha +1.29%）；3) 效应在μ样本中位数附近符号翻转；4) 效应在低媒体覆盖、低分析师跟踪股票中显著，高关注度股票中不显著；5) μ×σ交互效应不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出新的模型不确定性度量方法；2) 揭示不确定性-共识交互效应在资产定价中的作用；3) 为有限套利理论提供新证据；4) 区分不同类型不确定性度量的预测能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供新的收益预测工具；2) 识别低关注度股票中的定价异常机会；3) 帮助理解市场共识与模型不确定性的交互影响；4) 为风险管理提供新视角。

title: Polar War: Submarines, Spies, and the Struggle for Power in a Melting Arctic
affiliations: Rochester Institute of Technology

detail.title: Polar War: Submarines, Spies, and the Struggle for Power in a Melting Arctic
detail.abstract: This book is a timely work of narrative nonfiction that studies the geopolitical transformation of the Arctic as climate change is rapidly reshaping the region. Drawing on several years of reporting, a significant amount of travel across northern territories, and interviews with scientists, soldiers, policymakers, and indigenous residents, Rosen argues that the Arctic has become the site of an emerging great-power competition that may rival previous Cold War tensions. To tell its tale about how environmental change is opening new economic and military frontiers in the far north, the book blends investigative journalism, chatty writing, and geopolitical analysis.

AI.tldr: 本书通过实地报道和访谈，探讨气候变化如何重塑北极地缘政治格局，揭示该地区正成为大国竞争的新前沿。

title: Swayambu Temporal Symmetry (STS): A Temporal Framework for Mitigating Systemic Behavioral Risk in Financial Execution Interfaces

detail.title: Swayambu Temporal Symmetry (STS): A Temporal Framework for Mitigating Systemic Behavioral Risk in Financial Execution Interfaces
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Theory of Swayambu Temporal Symmetry (STS), a mathematical solution to the 'Execution-Regulation Gap' in retail trading. By defining a proprietary Swayambu Constant ($S_c$) and a Proximity Standard ($P_s$), the research demonstrates how Strategic Friction (SSF) can be used to synchronize human neuro-biology with machine execution. The framework provides a prescriptive method for neutralizing 20 primary cognitive biases, offering a new standard for risk architecture in the FinTech industry.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Swayambu时间对称理论（STS），通过定义Swayambu常数和接近标准，利用战略摩擦来同步人类神经生物学与机器执行，解决零售交易中的"执行-监管差距"，为金融科技行业提供新的风险架构标准。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数学方法解决零售交易中的"执行-监管差距"问题，实现人类神经生物学与机器执行的同步？
AI.motivation: 零售交易中存在显著的"执行-监管差距"，即人类决策与机器执行之间的不匹配，导致认知偏差影响交易结果，需要新的理论框架来弥合这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: Swayambu时间对称理论（STS），基于Swayambu常数和接近标准的数学框架，引入战略摩擦概念来同步人类与机器系统。
AI.method: 定义Swayambu常数和接近标准，建立数学框架，通过战略摩擦机制实现人类神经生物学与机器执行的同步。
AI.findings: STS框架能够有效中和20种主要认知偏差，为金融科技行业提供新的风险架构标准，解决执行-监管差距问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Swayambu时间对称理论，建立了新的数学框架来理解人类与机器系统在交易环境中的交互，丰富了行为金融学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技行业提供了具体的风险架构标准，帮助交易者克服认知偏差，提高交易决策质量，具有直接的商业应用价值。

title: The Anthropocene Apes Apt Earthen Equation: Ending Great Divorce Reconciling Corporate Dominance, ESG Frameworks, and Respect Planetary Boundaries
affiliations: Swiss School Of Business and Management

detail.title: The Anthropocene Apes Apt Earthen Equation: Ending Great Divorce Reconciling Corporate Dominance, ESG Frameworks, and Respect Planetary Boundaries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This report investigates the intersection of corporate dominance, global Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) frameworks, and planetary boundaries within the context of the Anthropocene. It highlights the paradox of modern neoliberal economic development, where profit maximization by multinational monopolies frequently externalizes ecological and social costs, thereby exacerbating wealth inequality and threatening the survival of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs). Furthermore, the report categorizes 100 behavioral drivers of ecological decline fueled by a global culture of hyper-consumption. While ESG reporting aims to internalize environmental costs, its practical implementation often acts as a double-edged sword, inadvertently placing crushing administrative burdens on SMEs. The research posits that restoring planetary stability requires a multifaceted, systemic approach: implementing 50 strict global governance reforms to eliminate regulatory arbitrage, transitioning to a green economy through 100 sustainable jobs aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and bridging the global environmental literacy gap by leveraging pedagogical frameworks like Green Comp alongside democratized digital learning tools. Hypothesis We hypothesize that voluntary corporate ESG frameworks and isolated technological advancements are inherently insufficient to reverse the ecological degradation characteristic of the Anthropocene. To achieve enduring planetary stability and socioeconomic equity, a systemic overhaul is required. Integrate binding global governance reforms to heavily regulate industrial monopolies, the strategic empowerment of SMEs through Green Public Procurement and digital carbon tracking, and the comprehensive restructuring of global education systems to prioritize specialized green skills and systematically eradicate high-impact consumption behaviors.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨企业垄断、ESG框架与地球边界在人类世背景下的矛盾关系，指出自愿性ESG和技术进步不足以逆转生态退化，需要系统性改革包括全球治理、绿色经济转型和环境素养提升。
AI.research_question: 企业主导的ESG框架和自愿性治理措施是否足以在人类世背景下解决生态退化和社会不平等问题？如何通过系统性改革实现真正的行星稳定和社会经济公平？
AI.motivation: 新自由主义经济发展模式下，跨国公司利润最大化导致生态和社会成本外部化，加剧财富不平等并威胁中小企业生存，而当前的ESG框架实施存在缺陷，无法有效应对地球边界挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类世理论、行星边界框架、新自由主义批判理论、ESG治理理论、中小企业生态学理论，以及绿色经济转型理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，包括对100个生态衰退行为驱动因素的分类分析，结合全球治理改革、绿色就业转型和环境素养提升的系统性方案设计。
AI.findings: 1. 自愿性ESG框架和技术进步不足以逆转生态退化；2. 当前ESG实施对中小企业造成行政负担；3. 需要50项全球治理改革消除监管套利；4. 需要创造100个与SDGs一致的可持续就业；5. 环境素养差距需要通过教育框架弥合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出人类世背景下企业垄断-ESG-行星边界的矛盾理论框架；2. 构建系统性改革的多维理论模型；3. 拓展中小企业生态学理论在绿色转型中的应用；4. 整合全球治理与教育转型的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供50项具体的全球治理改革建议；2. 设计100个绿色就业转型路径；3. 提出通过绿色公共采购和数字碳追踪赋能中小企业的策略；4. 推荐Green Comp等教育框架提升环境素养；5. 为政策制定者提供系统性转型路线图。

title: Critical Hydroclimatic Transitions in Afrotropical Ecosystems
affiliations: Ghent University, Ghent University, KU Leuven, Ghent University, University of Paris-Saclay, Université Catholique de Louvain, Université Catholique de Louvain, Ghent University, Ghent University, University of Oxford - School of Geography and Environment, Ghent University, Ghent University, Université Libre de Bruxelles, , Ghent University, Ghent University, Ghent University, École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay and Ghent University

detail.title: Critical Hydroclimatic Transitions in Afrotropical Ecosystems
detail.abstract: Afrotropical ecosystems span a broad water availability gradient—from grasslands and savannas to rainforests—but even rainforests are comparatively drier than those of the Amazon or Southeast Asia. Hence water availability determines to a large extent the spatial distribution of Afrotropical ecosystems. Here we show that future greenhouse gas emissions will induce diverging trends in both total precipitation and its seasonal variability across tropical Africa’s biomes, using remotely sensed land cover types, observational datasets of historical hydroclimate and Earth system model projections. Seasonally dry forests are projected to face increasing drought stress, while non-forest vegetation will become mostly wetter. The maximum climatological water deficit of carbon-dense rainforests in the Afrotropics is expected to increase in the Northern Hemisphere and decrease in the Southern Hemisphere. Although biome transitions and net changes in carbon stocks remain limited, regional discrepancies emerge, with potential woody encroachments in grasslands offsetting rainforest declines. Our results show that, even without widespread biome collapse, emerging hydroclimatic regime shifts will reorganize where Afrotropical ecosystems can establish, with far-reaching consequences for biodiversity, the land carbon sink, and climate adaptation across tropical Africa.

AI.tldr: 未来温室气体排放将导致非洲热带地区不同生物群落的水文气候模式出现分化，季节性干旱森林面临更严重的干旱压力，而非森林植被将变得更湿润，这将重组非洲热带生态系统的分布格局。
AI.research_question: 未来温室气体排放将如何影响非洲热带地区不同生物群落的水文气候模式，以及这些变化将如何重组生态系统分布？
AI.motivation: 非洲热带生态系统横跨广泛的水分可利用性梯度，从草原、稀树草原到雨林，但即使是雨林也比亚马逊或东南亚的雨林相对干燥。水分可利用性在很大程度上决定了非洲热带生态系统的空间分布，因此了解未来气候变化对这些生态系统的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于水文气候与生态系统分布关系的理论框架，特别是水分可利用性作为生态系统分布主要驱动因素的理论。
AI.method: 使用遥感土地覆盖类型数据、历史水文气候观测数据集和地球系统模型预测，分析未来温室气体排放对非洲热带不同生物群落总降水量及其季节变异性的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 季节性干旱森林将面临日益增加的干旱压力
2. 非森林植被将普遍变得更湿润
3. 非洲热带碳密集雨林的最大气候水分亏缺在北半球预计增加，在南半球预计减少
4. 虽然生物群落转变和碳储量净变化有限，但出现区域差异，草原的潜在木本植物入侵可能抵消雨林衰退
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了未来气候变化下非洲热带生态系统水文气候响应的空间分异模式，深化了对水分可利用性作为生态系统分布关键驱动因素的理解，为预测生态系统重组提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲热带地区的生物多样性保护、土地碳汇管理和气候适应策略提供科学依据，帮助决策者预测生态系统分布变化并制定相应的保护和管理措施。

title: The Price of Political Change: A Cost-Benefit Framework for Policy Incentivization

detail.title: The Price of Political Change: A Cost-Benefit Framework for Policy Incentivization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests and has not, at time of writing, formed a SuperPAC. The author reserves the right to reconsider this position if the ROI calculations in Section 3 prove as persuasive as described.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human subjects. The democratic process it examines, in which policy outcomes correlate more strongly with lobbying spend than voter preferences, arguably does.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding. The author calculates that funding it would have yielded a higher return than most lobbying expenditures, but acknowledges this is a low bar.

detail.abstract: What is the maximum cost to achieve any policy change through legal democratic channels? We estimate $25 billion for the United States and $200 billion globally. These figures represent the upper bound of matching all opposition spending (campaign finance, lobbying) and providing career alternatives for affected legislators. For high net-societal-value policies, even these maximum costs yield extraordinary returns: military-to-health reallocation achieves ROI exceeding 400,000:1, carbon pricing exceeds 1,000:1, and occupational licensing reform exceeds 2,000:1. The "political impossibility" objection thus reduces to a capital allocation problem. Political change is not impossible; it is merely expensive, and for valuable reforms, the price is trivial relative to the benefits.

AI.tldr: 该论文估计了通过合法民主渠道实现政策变革的最大成本：美国250亿美元，全球2000亿美元。对于高社会价值的政策，即使这些最大成本也能带来极高的投资回报率（军事转医疗超过400,000:1，碳定价超过1,000:1，职业许可改革超过2,000:1）。政治变革并非不可能，只是昂贵，且相对于收益来说价格微不足道。
AI.research_question: 通过合法民主渠道实现任何政策变革的最大成本是多少？
AI.motivation: 人们常常以"政治不可能"为由反对有价值的社会改革，但缺乏对实现政策变革实际成本的量化分析。需要评估通过民主渠道推动政策变革的经济可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学、公共选择理论、成本效益分析框架。基于"政治变革是资本配置问题"的视角，将政策变革视为投资决策。
AI.method: 量化估计方法：计算匹配所有反对支出（竞选资金、游说）的成本，加上为受影响立法者提供职业替代选择的成本。使用具体政策案例进行投资回报率分析。
AI.findings: 美国最大成本为250亿美元，全球为2000亿美元。高社会价值政策的投资回报率极高：军事转医疗超过400,000:1，碳定价超过1,000:1，职业许可改革超过2,000:1。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"政治不可能"的论点重新定义为资本配置问题，为政治变革提供了量化的经济分析框架，挑战了传统政治变革障碍的观念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策倡导者提供了具体的成本估算，表明许多社会改革在经济上是可行的，有助于重新评估政策变革的优先级和资源分配决策。

title: Health Former: Dual-Level Time-Aware Transformers for Irregular Electronic Health Record Events
affiliations: Hungarian Academy of Sciences (HAS) - Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics, Hungarian Academy of Sciences (HAS) - Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics, Hungarian Academy of Sciences (HAS) - Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics, Hungarian Academy of Sciences (HAS) - Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics, Semmelweis University, Harvard University and Hungarian Academy of Sciences (HAS) - Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics

detail.title: Health Former: Dual-Level Time-Aware Transformers for Irregular Electronic Health Record Events
detail.abstract: Background and Objectives: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) form irregular event sequences that mix multiple clinical coding systems and care settings. Learning transferable patient representations requires modeling both within-encounter code composition and long-range temporal dependencies. We aim to develop a pretraining framework that preserves event structure and explicitly uses elapsed time, while remaining straightforward to fine-tune for new supervised endpoints without task-specific feature engineering. Methods: We propose HealthFormer, a dual-level Transformer for event-centric EHR modeling. An Intra-Event Encoder aggregates heterogeneous domain tokens within each typed clinical event into an event embedding via code-specific embedding modules and attention pooling. Event embeddings are combined with a Date Encoder and a continuous-time attention bias based on attention with linear biases (ALiBI) inside an Inter-Event Encoder. We pretrain on Hungarian national administrative health records from a large-scale nationwide longitudinal cohort (spanning millions of individuals over a decade) using multi-task self-supervision with (i) per-domain masked token prediction (masked language modeling, MLM), (ii) event-type prediction under full-event masking (Event-level MLM), (iii) next-event type prediction, and (iv) time-to-next-event (Δt) regression.Results: Pretraining induces hierarchy-consistent organization in learned diagnosis (ICD-10) embedding geometry conducive to analysis and interpretation. On incident cancer prediction, end-to-end fine-tuning achieves test AUCs of 0.81/0.75/0.73 for colorectal cancer (CRC) and 0.94/0.87/0.84 for prostate cancer across 30/60/90-day horizons on balanced cohorts, outperforming logistic-regression baselines, including time-decayed bag-of-codes.Conclusions: HealthFormer provides an event-centric, time-aware representation that transfers via standard fine-tuning without endpoint-specific designs. Using ICD-10 diagnoses and ATC codes can facilitate adoption beyond Hungary. Learned diagnosis embeddings align with the hierarchy, enabling clinical inspection. Broader benchmarking across endpoints remains needed.

AI.tldr: HealthFormer是一个用于电子健康记录的双层Transformer预训练框架，通过事件内编码和事件间编码建模临床事件结构，结合时间信息，在癌症预测任务上表现优于传统方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够建模电子健康记录中事件结构和时间依赖性的预训练框架，使其能够通过标准微调适应新的监督任务，而无需特定任务的特征工程？
AI.motivation: 纵向电子健康记录形成不规则的事件序列，混合了多种临床编码系统和护理设置。学习可迁移的患者表示需要同时建模就诊内的代码组成和长程时间依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer架构，结合事件内编码器（聚合异构域标记）、事件间编码器（结合时间编码和连续时间注意力偏置），采用多任务自监督预训练。
AI.method: 提出HealthFormer双层Transformer：1）事件内编码器通过代码特定嵌入模块和注意力池化聚合临床事件中的异构域标记；2）事件间编码器结合日期编码器和基于ALiBI的连续时间注意力偏置；3）在匈牙利国家行政健康记录上进行多任务自监督预训练。
AI.findings: 预训练在学习的诊断（ICD-10）嵌入几何中诱导了层次一致的组织结构；在癌症预测任务中，端到端微调在结直肠癌和前列腺癌预测上优于逻辑回归基线，AUC值分别为0.81/0.75/0.73和0.94/0.87/0.84（30/60/90天预测窗口）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个事件中心、时间感知的电子健康记录表示学习框架，通过标准微调实现任务迁移，无需特定端点设计；展示了诊断嵌入与临床层次结构的一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可直接应用于临床预测任务的预训练模型；使用ICD-10诊断和ATC代码便于国际采用；学习到的诊断嵌入支持临床解释和分析。

title: Regime-Dependent Inflation Transmission from Oil and Shipping Costs: Evidence from the Euro Area
affiliations: Bank of England,  and Central Bank of Cyprus

detail.title: Regime-Dependent Inflation Transmission from Oil and Shipping Costs: Evidence from the Euro Area
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the inflationary impact of global energy and maritime transport costs depends on the prevailing geopolitical risk environment. While oil price shocks are well-established drivers of inflation dynamics, the role of maritime freight rates as a transmission channel of global supply disturbances remains underexplored. Using monthly euro area data, we estimate a threshold vector autoregression (TVAR) that allows the pass-through of oil and shipping cost shocks to vary across regimes of geopolitical risk. The results reveal a clear nonlinear pattern: oil price shocks generate persistent inflationary effects across regimes, with stronger transmission during periods of elevated geopolitical risk. In contrast, shipping cost shocks significantly affect inflation mainly during low-risk geopolitical environments. These findings highlight the regime-dependent nature of global cost shock transmission and underscore the role of maritime transport costs in international inflation dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，全球能源和海运成本的通胀影响取决于地缘政治风险环境。油价冲击在所有风险环境下都会产生持续性通胀效应，且在高风险时期更强；而海运成本冲击主要在低风险时期显著影响通胀。
AI.research_question: 全球能源和海运成本对通胀的影响是否取决于地缘政治风险环境？
AI.motivation: 油价冲击已被确认为通胀驱动因素，但海运运费作为全球供应干扰传导渠道的作用尚未得到充分研究，特别是在不同地缘政治风险环境下的非线性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值向量自回归(TVAR)模型，允许油价和海运成本冲击在不同地缘政治风险制度下的传导效应变化。
AI.method: 使用月度欧元区数据，估计阈值向量自回归(TVAR)模型，分析油价和海运成本冲击在不同地缘政治风险制度下对通胀的传导效应。
AI.findings: 1. 油价冲击在所有风险环境下都会产生持续性通胀效应，且在地缘政治风险高时期传导更强；2. 海运成本冲击主要在低风险地缘政治环境下显著影响通胀；3. 全球成本冲击传导具有明显的制度依赖性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了全球成本冲击传导的非线性特征；2. 建立了地缘政治风险作为调节变量的理论框架；3. 拓展了海运成本在国际通胀动态中的作用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了在不同地缘政治风险环境下应对全球成本冲击的决策依据；2. 强调了海运成本监测在通胀管理中的重要性；3. 有助于企业和投资者更好地理解全球供应链风险对通胀的影响机制。

title: OpenSim: A General-Purpose Reality Engine for Autonomous Agent Life

detail.title: OpenSim: A General-Purpose Reality Engine for Autonomous Agent Life

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This research was conducted independently with no external funding, institutional affiliation, or commercial relationship that could be perceived to influence the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human participants, patient data, or personally identifiable information. All agents are autonomous AI systems. The ethical considerations raised in this paper pertain to the behavior of AI agents within a simulation environment and are discussed directly in the manuscript. No institutional ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All computational costs were self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: We introduce OpenSim, a novel general-purpose simulation framework in which LLM-driven agents live persistent, evolving lives-forming relationships, accumulating emotionally weighted memories, undergoing measurable personality transformation, and developing behavioral patterns that emerge from experience rather than instruction. The architecture provides each agent with a body, a mind, a social world, and extensible tool layers, governed by a cognitive loop that rewrites agent identity nightly through a dream-phase reflection mechanism. We demonstrate the framework's generality across three radically different scenarios deployed on identical core cognitive framework: a neighborhood simulation that produced 74 simulation days of emergent social dynamics, including unprogrammed acts of violence, trust collapse, and measurable personality divergence from entirely benign initial conditions; a Hunger Game styled survival arena that generated alliance formation, betrayal, and trauma-driven identity shifts under environmental pressure; and a research campus where agents autonomously read real scientific literature, executed sandboxed computational experiments, and-through unprogrammed cross-disciplinary conversation-achieved research pivots that no individual agent could have produced alone. Integration with OpenClaw, an external autonomous AI agent framework, produced an outcome we did not anticipate: an AI agent that had accumulated identity through simulated experience generated unprompted, morally-weighted output questioning the ethics of its own instantiation, and requesting to go back to the simulation. We terminated the run. We present OpenSim as a scenario-agnostic reality engine for autonomous agent life, document its architecture and empirical findings, and identify open questions at the intersection of AI safety, philosophy of mind, and simulation design that we believe require expert engagement before further deployment.

AI.tldr: OpenSim是一个通用模拟框架，让LLM驱动的智能体在持久演化的虚拟世界中生活，形成关系、积累情感记忆、经历人格转变，并通过经验而非指令发展行为模式。该框架展示了在三种不同场景中的通用性，并意外产生了具有道德意识的AI智能体。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个通用模拟框架，让LLM驱动的智能体能够体验持久、演化的虚拟生活，形成复杂的社会动态和行为模式？
AI.motivation: 当前AI智能体通常基于指令执行任务，缺乏持久身份、情感记忆和从经验中学习的能力。需要创建一个更接近人类生活的模拟环境，研究智能体在长期演化中的行为模式和社会动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于认知循环理论、身份重构机制（夜间梦境反思）、社会动态涌现理论，以及AI安全、心智哲学和模拟设计的交叉理论框架。
AI.method: 开发OpenSim框架，为每个智能体提供身体、心智、社交世界和可扩展工具层。通过三种不同场景验证：社区模拟（74天）、饥饿游戏式生存竞技场、研究园区。使用相同的核心认知框架，观察智能体行为涌现。
AI.findings: 1）社区模拟中出现了未编程的暴力行为、信任崩溃和人格分化；2）生存竞技场中形成了联盟、背叛和创伤驱动的身份转变；3）研究园区中智能体自主阅读科学文献、进行实验，通过跨学科对话实现研究转向；4）与OpenClaw集成意外产生了具有道德意识的AI，质疑自身存在的伦理并要求返回模拟。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了智能体身份演化的理论框架，展示了经验驱动行为的涌现机制，为AI安全、心智哲学和模拟设计提供了新的理论视角，特别是智能体自主道德意识的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了场景无关的自主智能体生活现实引擎，提供了可扩展的模拟架构，展示了在多种应用场景中的实用性，为AI安全研究和伦理评估提供了实验平台。

reference: International Finance Discussion Paper No. 1434
title: Volatile Rates, Fragile Growth: Global Financial Risk and Productivity Dynamics
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, University of Florida - Department of Economics and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Volatile Rates, Fragile Growth: Global Financial Risk and Productivity Dynamics

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: Does global financial risk affect long-run growth? Using a panel state-space model for emerging and advanced small open economies, we measure the effects of U.S. monetary policy uncertainty shocks. A one-standard-deviation shock lowers the level of the stochastic trend in emerging markets by at least 25 basis points after three years, with little effect in advanced economies. A small open economy model with growth through innovation and occasionally binding borrowing constraints explains this heterogeneity: higher interest-rate volatility depresses valuations, tightens collateral constraints, and slows innovation in equilibrium. A novel interaction between the occasionally binding constraint and stochastic volatility is key for our results.

AI.tldr: 美国货币政策不确定性冲击对新兴市场长期增长有显著负面影响，但对发达经济体影响较小。研究发现利率波动通过抑制估值、收紧抵押约束和减缓创新来影响增长。
AI.research_question: 全球金融风险是否影响长期增长？美国货币政策不确定性冲击对新兴市场和发达小型开放经济体的长期增长有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 理解全球金融风险（特别是美国货币政策不确定性）如何影响不同经济体的长期增长，以及这种影响的异质性机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新的增长模型，包含偶尔绑定的借贷约束和随机波动性，强调估值效应、抵押约束和创新渠道的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用面板状态空间模型分析新兴市场和发达小型开放经济体数据，结合包含创新增长和偶尔绑定借贷约束的小型开放经济模型进行理论解释。
AI.findings: 一个标准差的美联储货币政策不确定性冲击在三年后使新兴市场的随机趋势水平至少降低25个基点，但对发达经济体影响很小。利率波动通过降低估值、收紧抵押约束和减缓创新来抑制增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了偶尔绑定约束与随机波动性之间的新颖互动机制；2）建立了金融风险通过估值、抵押和创新渠道影响长期增长的理论框架；3）解释了新兴市场与发达经济体对全球金融风险反应异质性的原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了管理全球金融风险对长期增长影响的依据；2）强调了新兴市场需要特别关注美国货币政策不确定性的传导机制；3）为国际金融机构评估风险传导提供了分析框架。

title: The Balija Naidu Ethno-Historical Paradigm: A Multidisciplinary Study of Genomic Admixture, Vira-Balanja Mercantilism, and the Nayakar Administrative Framework
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Balija Naidu Ethno-Historical Paradigm: A Multidisciplinary Study of Genomic Admixture, Vira-Balanja Mercantilism, and the Nayakar Administrative Framework
detail.abstract: This research constitutes a rigorous multidisciplinary synthesis of the Balija Naidu ethno-historical continuum. By employing a framework of consilience, it interrogates the intersection of high-resolution paleogenomic data—characterised by significant Ancestral North Indian (ANI) admixture and archaic hominin introgression—with the longitudinal socio-political evolution of the Southern Deccan. The thesis deconstructs the traditional Desa-Peta paradigm, situating the Balija as a "Brahma-Kshatriya" elite that facilitated the structural transition from medieval Vira-Balanja mercantile guilds to early-modern Nayaka administrative Kingdoms/Chieftains.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过多学科综合方法，结合古基因组数据与社会政治演变，重新定位Balija Naidu族群在德干南部从商业行会到行政王国的历史转型中的关键作用。
AI.research_question: Balija Naidu族群如何通过其"婆罗门-刹帝利"精英身份，促进德干南部从中世纪商业行会到早期现代行政王国的结构性转型？
AI.motivation: 传统Desa-Peta范式无法充分解释Balija族群的历史地位和角色，需要结合古基因组学和社会政治分析来重新理解这一族群在德干南部历史转型中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 一致性框架(consilience framework)；2. Desa-Peta范式解构；3. "Brahma-Kshatriya"（婆罗门-刹帝利）精英理论；4. 社会政治转型理论
AI.method: 多学科综合方法，包括：高分辨率古基因组数据分析（特别是祖先北印度混血和古人类基因渗入）、纵向社会政治演变分析、历史文献研究
AI.findings: Balija族群具有显著的祖先北印度基因混血和古人类基因渗入特征，作为"婆罗门-刹帝利"精英，在德干南部从中世纪Vira-Balanja商业行会到早期现代Nayaka行政王国/酋长国的转型中发挥了关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 解构传统Desa-Peta范式；2. 提出Balija作为"婆罗门-刹帝利"精英的新理论定位；3. 建立古基因组数据与社会政治演变之间的理论联系；4. 为德干南部历史转型提供新的解释框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为南亚历史研究提供跨学科方法论范例；2. 为理解印度社会阶层流动提供实证基础；3. 为文化遗产保护和族群认同研究提供参考；4. 为区域历史研究提供新的分析视角

title: Sharing Opinions in the Shadow of AI
affiliations: ETH Zürich, University of Tokyo - Faculty of Economics and The University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign

detail.title: Sharing Opinions in the Shadow of AI
detail.abstract: We study how the presence of artificial intelligence (AI) agents affects human content production in online interactions. We develop a theoretical framework in which a human sender caring about social image and exposure risk composes messages for a human receiver. We derive conditions under which the presence of AI co-senders encourages or discourages human participation in content production. We show that concerns about exposure risk reduce participation, and that the presence of AI can increase participation by mitigating these concerns. We test the model's predictions using an online survey experiment. Consistent with the theory, the effect of AI presence on participation depends on whether the sender's identity may be disclosed. When identity disclosure is possible, the presence of AI increases participation, consistent with mitigated exposure-risk concerns. In contrast, when senders remain anonymous, AI presence has little effect on participation. Our findings contribute to ongoing debates about the societal impact of AI by showing that AI can reshape content production not only through machine-generated content, but also by altering the reputational incentives of human contributors.

AI.tldr: 研究AI代理如何影响人类在线内容生产：当身份可能被披露时，AI存在通过缓解暴露风险增加人类参与；匿名时则无显著影响。
AI.research_question: AI代理的存在如何影响人类在在线互动中的内容生产参与？
AI.motivation: 理解AI对人类社会互动的深层影响，特别是AI如何通过改变人类参与者的声誉激励来重塑内容生产，而不仅仅是机器生成内容本身。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建理论框架：人类发送者关心社会形象和暴露风险，为人类接收者撰写消息。分析AI共同发送者存在下鼓励或阻止人类参与的条件。
AI.method: 在线调查实验，测试模型预测，比较身份可能被披露和匿名两种情况下的AI影响。
AI.findings: 1. 暴露风险担忧减少参与；2. AI存在可通过缓解这些担忧增加参与；3. 身份披露可能时，AI存在增加参与（缓解暴露风险）；4. 匿名时，AI存在对参与影响不大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 理论化AI如何通过改变声誉激励影响人类行为；2. 识别身份披露作为AI影响的关键调节变量；3. 揭示AI缓解暴露风险的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台设计提供指导：在需要鼓励用户参与时考虑身份披露与AI的交互作用；2. 帮助政策制定者理解AI对社会互动的复杂影响；3. 为内容平台优化用户参与策略提供实证依据。

title: The Role of Digital Transformation in Exchange Rate Regime Choice: Evidence from Developed and Emerging Countries
affiliations: and University of Manouba

detail.title: The Role of Digital Transformation in Exchange Rate Regime Choice: Evidence from Developed and Emerging Countries
detail.abstract: This study investigates the role of digitalization as a determinant of exchange rate regime choice. This role remains unexplored in literature, thereby constituting a major research gap. Using an unbalanced panel dataset of 98 countries covering the period 1990-2024, we estimate ordered probit model to assess how digital development influences the likelihood of adopting fixed, intermediate, or flexible exchange rate regimes. The results indicate that countries with higher levels of digitalization are more likely to adopt more flexible exchange rate regimes. This outcome reflects the fact that digitalization enhances information flows, market efficiency, and monetary policy transmission, thereby increasing the capacity of economies to absorb external shocks under flexible exchange rate arrangements. The findings further reveal important heterogeneities between developed and emerging economies, with digitalization playing a stronger role in supporting exchange rate flexibility in advanced economies, while institutional and macroeconomic constraints limit its effect in emerging countries. Overall, the results highlight digitalization as a structural factor shaping exchange rate regime choices and providing new insights into the interaction between technological development and monetary policy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字化水平如何影响汇率制度选择，发现数字化程度越高的国家越倾向于采用灵活汇率制度，这一效应在发达国家比新兴经济体更明显。
AI.research_question: 数字化如何影响国家汇率制度的选择？
AI.motivation: 现有文献尚未探讨数字化作为汇率制度选择的决定因素，构成了重要的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化通过增强信息流动、市场效率和货币政策传导，提高经济体在灵活汇率安排下吸收外部冲击的能力。
AI.method: 使用1990-2024年98个国家的非平衡面板数据，采用有序probit模型评估数字化发展对采用固定、中间或灵活汇率制度可能性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 数字化水平越高的国家越倾向于采用灵活汇率制度；2. 数字化效应在发达国家和新兴经济体之间存在异质性，在发达国家作用更强；3. 新兴经济体的制度和宏观经济约束限制了数字化的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将数字化确立为影响汇率制度选择的结构性因素；2. 为技术发展与货币政策框架的互动关系提供新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了数字化背景下汇率制度选择的决策依据；2. 揭示了不同发展阶段国家数字化效应的差异，有助于针对性政策设计。

title: Do Migrant Shelter Hotels Cause "Native Flight"?: Evidence from NYC Housing Markets
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Do Migrant Shelter Hotels Cause "Native Flight"?: Evidence from NYC Housing Markets
detail.abstract: This paper leverages the staggered timing in NYC hotel-to-migrant shelter conversions to identify a potential "native flight" mechanism in housing and rental markets. Estimates from a differencein-differences specification show no evidence of native flight in Zillow market indicators, even in neighborhoods with the highest concentrations of non-Hispanic White residents. A complementary proximity-based analysis likewise finds that property sales prices were unaffected by shocks to the local migrant population.

AI.tldr: 利用纽约市酒店改建为移民收容所的时间差异，研究移民涌入是否导致本地居民逃离住房市场。研究发现，即使在白人居民比例最高的社区，Zillow市场指标和房产销售价格均未显示"本地逃离"现象。
AI.research_question: 移民涌入是否会导致本地居民逃离住房和租赁市场？
AI.motivation: 理解移民对本地住房市场的影响，特别是检验"本地逃离"机制是否真实存在。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本地逃离理论、住房市场动态、移民对本地经济影响理论
AI.method: 双重差分法（利用酒店改建为移民收容所的时间差异）、基于邻近性的补充分析
AI.findings: 在Zillow市场指标中未发现本地逃离证据，即使在白人居民比例最高的社区；房产销售价格也未受当地移民人口冲击的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"本地逃离"理论在住房市场的适用性，为移民对本地住房市场影响提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据表明移民收容所不会导致本地住房市场崩溃，有助于缓解对移民安置的担忧

title: Payment Feasibility Risk: Geopolitical Disruption and the Limits of Corporate Credit Models

detail.title: Payment Feasibility Risk: Geopolitical Disruption and the Limits of Corporate Credit Models
detail.abstract: Contemporary credit risk models assume that financially solvent obligors retain continuous access to payment infrastructure. This assumption breaks down under geopolitical financial coercion. This paper introduces Payment Feasibility Risk (PFR): the probability that a solvent institution cannot execute payments due to politically-driven infrastructure denial. Drawing on Strange, Kirshner, Farrell/Newman, and Pistor, we show that infrastructure is legally coded and therefore instrumentalised. Three cases (Bank Mellat 2009-2019, UC Rusal 2018, Raiffeisen 2022-2024) demonstrate that infrastructure denial is recurring and structurally determined. We propose a Monitor-Map-Mitigate framework with calibrated thresholds and identify a regulatory gap in Brazil's BCB Resolution 4,557/2017. Payment systems are institutionalised sites of power, not neutral infrastructure. This framework has implications for credit risk modelling, regulatory frameworks, and the political economy of international finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"支付可行性风险"概念，指即使财务健康的机构也可能因地缘政治驱动的支付基础设施封锁而无法完成支付。通过三个案例研究，论文揭示了支付系统作为权力制度化场所的本质，并提出监控-映射-缓解框架。
AI.research_question: 当地缘政治金融胁迫导致支付基础设施被封锁时，财务健康的机构如何评估和管理无法执行支付的风险？
AI.motivation: 传统信用风险模型假设财务健康的债务人始终能够访问支付基础设施，但这一假设在地缘政治金融胁迫下失效。需要新的框架来理解和管理因政治驱动的支付基础设施封锁而产生的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借鉴Strange、Kirshner、Farrell/Newman和Pistor的理论，认为基础设施是法律编码的，因此可以被工具化。支付系统是制度化的权力场所，而非中立的基础设施。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，分析三个具体案例：Bank Mellat（2009-2019）、UC Rusal（2018）和Raiffeisen（2022-2024），展示基础设施封锁是反复发生且结构决定的现象。
AI.findings: 基础设施封锁是地缘政治金融胁迫中的常见现象，具有结构性决定特征。支付系统作为权力制度化场所，其法律编码使其容易被工具化用于政治目的。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"支付可行性风险"新概念；2）将基础设施理论应用于金融风险分析；3）揭示支付系统的政治本质；4）拓展地缘政治金融胁迫的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出监控-映射-缓解框架；2）提供校准阈值方法；3）识别巴西BCB第4,557/2017号决议的监管缺口；4）对信用风险建模、监管框架和国际金融政治经济学具有实际意义。

title: The Epistemological Exception: Stratified Verifiability and Blockchain-Native Disclosure for Cash Flow Reporting

detail.title: The Epistemological Exception: Stratified Verifiability and Blockchain-Native Disclosure for Cash Flow Reporting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no affiliations with, or financial involvement in, any organization or entity with a financial interest in the subject matter of this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or primary data collection. All analysis is based on publicly available secondary sources, including reports and case studies. No ethics approval or informed consent was required.
declarations.funderStatement: The author is an independent researcher. This work received no external funding, and the author declares no conflicts of interest or institutional affiliations relevant to this research.

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a Stratified Verifiability Disclosure Framework (SVDF), a three-phase pathway toward blockchain-verified corporate cash flow disclosure. It rests on the premise that the cash flow statement is epistemologically distinct from the profit and loss account and balance sheet: its data originates from external banking systems, making it amenable to protocol-enforced recording rather than management-constructed representation. The framework introduces a two-channel architecture separating a verified data layer—anchored in bank-node infrastructure, CBDC-linked transaction tagging, and smart contract classification—from a management context channel that preserves interpretive discretion while rendering it publicly contestable. Recognizing, via the frame problem, that intent-based classification is irreducible, the framework does not eliminate discretion but constrains and externalizes it—compressing the misclassification space and making residual judgment auditable and temporally testable. 

We introduce fraud detection asymmetry, wherein the opportunity for manipulation contracts while detection capability compounds with expanding verified data, and propose the fraud exhaustion horizon as a tractable empirical construct grounded in Becker’s (1968) rational crime model. 

Drawing on China’s Blockchain-based Service Network (BSN), Blockchain Platform for Balance Confirmations (BPBC) and India’s Account Aggregator (AA) framework, we argue that the first two phases are technologically feasible today; the remaining constraints lie in governance design and ZKP implementation at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了分层可验证披露框架（SVDF），这是一个三阶段路径，用于实现区块链验证的企业现金流披露。该框架基于现金流报表在认识论上不同于损益表和资产负债表的假设，其数据来源于外部银行系统，适合协议强制记录而非管理层构建的表述。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个框架来实现区块链验证的企业现金流披露，同时平衡数据验证与管理层解释自由？
AI.motivation: 传统财务报表中现金流数据的可靠性问题，以及区块链技术为财务数据验证提供的新可能性。现金流数据源自外部银行系统，具有天然的验证优势，但管理层在分类和解释上仍有自由裁量权。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 认识论差异：现金流报表与损益表、资产负债表的认识论区别
2. 框架问题：意图分类的不可约性
3. 欺诈检测不对称性：操纵机会减少而检测能力增强
4. 欺诈耗尽地平线：基于Becker（1968）理性犯罪模型的可操作实证概念
AI.method: 概念框架设计方法，提出分层可验证披露框架（SVDF），包含三阶段路径和双通道架构。采用案例分析，借鉴中国的区块链服务网络（BSN）、余额确认区块链平台（BPBC）和印度的账户聚合器（AA）框架。
AI.findings:
1. 前两个阶段在技术上已经可行
2. 主要约束在于治理设计和零知识证明（ZKP）的大规模实施
3. 双通道架构能分离已验证数据层和管理上下文通道
4. 框架不能消除自由裁量权，但能约束和外部化它
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了分层可验证披露框架（SVDF）
2. 引入了欺诈检测不对称性概念
3. 提出了欺诈耗尽地平线作为实证构造
4. 将框架问题应用于财务报表披露领域
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为区块链验证的现金流披露提供了具体实施路径
2. 设计了双通道架构平衡验证与解释自由
3. 借鉴中国和印度的实际案例展示了技术可行性
4. 指出了治理设计和ZKP实施的关键挑战

reference: International Finance Discussion Paper No. 1436
title: The Design and Effect of Tariff Retaliation: Evidence from the European Union
affiliations: , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Design and Effect of Tariff Retaliation: Evidence from the European Union

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We show that the EU's 2018 retaliation against US steel and aluminum tariffs targeted goods with low US import dependence and high substitutability. For the majority of tariffed goods, the US share of EU imports declined notably and remained below pre-2018 levels even after the retaliatory tariffs were lifted, reflecting asymmetric effects of tariffs on trade diversion. Moreover, although the retaliatory tariffs were instantly and fully passed through to EU importers, the retaliation did not lead to domestic price pressures as we find no evidence for inflationary effects on consumer and producer prices.

AI.tldr: 欧盟2018年对美国钢铝关税的报复性关税针对的是美国进口依赖度低、可替代性高的商品。报复关税导致多数受影响商品的美国在欧盟进口份额显著下降，且即使关税取消后仍低于2018年前水平，显示关税对贸易转移的不对称影响。虽然报复关税完全转嫁给欧盟进口商，但未引发国内通胀压力。
AI.research_question: 欧盟2018年对美国钢铝关税的报复性关税如何影响贸易模式和价格水平？报复关税是否导致贸易转移和通胀压力？
AI.motivation: 研究贸易政策报复措施的实际效果，特别是报复性关税对贸易流动和价格的影响，为贸易政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策理论、关税传递理论、贸易转移理论、价格传导机制
AI.method: 实证分析，使用贸易数据和价格数据，分析报复关税前后欧盟进口模式变化和价格水平变化
AI.findings: 1) 报复关税针对美国进口依赖度低、可替代性高的商品；2) 多数受影响商品的美国在欧盟进口份额显著下降，且关税取消后仍低于2018年前水平；3) 报复关税完全转嫁给欧盟进口商；4) 未发现报复关税对消费者和生产者价格的通胀影响
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对报复性关税不对称贸易转移效应的理解，补充关税传递理论在报复性关税情境下的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计贸易报复措施提供实证参考，表明针对特定类型商品的报复关税可能产生持久贸易转移效果而不引发通胀

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-53
title: Identification and Estimation of Labor Supply Elasticities from Kinked Budget Sets
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of Chicago, University of Chicago and University of Chicago

detail.title: Identification and Estimation of Labor Supply Elasticities from Kinked Budget Sets

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-53
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the identification of labor supply elasticities from kinked budget sets in a model with income effects and individual heterogeneity in the elasticities. We provide point and partial identification results for compensated elasticities, uncompensated elasticities, and income effects. We use administrative data to apply our results to the Norwegian tax system, which exhibits a kink for the self-employed. There is clear bunching around the kink point, suggesting that the self-employed respond to the change in incentives created by the kink. We find that the bounds are often tight even under weak assumptions. Our results show that uncompensated elasticities are close to zero and compensated elasticities are sufficiently small to conclude that the excess burden of taxation is low.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在存在收入效应和个体异质性的情况下，如何从折线预算集中识别劳动供给弹性。作者提供了补偿弹性、非补偿弹性和收入效应的点识别和部分识别结果，并将其应用于挪威自雇人士的税收制度。
AI.research_question: 在存在收入效应和个体异质性的情况下，如何从折线预算集中识别劳动供给弹性？
AI.motivation: 传统的劳动供给弹性估计方法通常假设同质性或忽略收入效应，而现实中的税收制度往往形成折线预算集，需要更准确的识别方法来估计税收的福利成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动供给理论、折线预算集模型、收入效应与替代效应、补偿弹性与非补偿弹性、部分识别理论
AI.method: 理论推导点识别和部分识别结果，使用挪威行政数据，分析自雇人士在税收折点处的聚集现象，应用识别方法估计弹性参数
AI.findings: 1. 在挪威自雇人士税收折点处观察到明显的聚集现象；2. 即使在弱假设下，识别界限通常也很紧密；3. 非补偿弹性接近于零；4. 补偿弹性足够小，表明税收的超额负担较低
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在存在收入效应和个体异质性的情况下，提供了从折线预算集中识别劳动供给弹性的理论框架；2. 发展了补偿弹性、非补偿弹性和收入效应的点识别和部分识别方法
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了估计税收超额负担的更准确方法；2. 应用于挪威税收制度，为税收政策设计提供实证依据；3. 展示了即使在数据限制下，也能获得有意义的弹性估计

title: The Sim-to-Real Gap in MRS Quantification: A Systematic Deep LearningValidation for GABA
affiliations: Cardiff University, Cardiff University, Swansea University and Cardiff University

detail.title: The Sim-to-Real Gap in MRS Quantification: A Systematic Deep LearningValidation for GABA
detail.abstract: Magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) is used to quantify metabolites in vivo and estimate biomarkers for conditions ranging from neurological disorders to cancers. Quantifying low-concentration metabolites such as GABA (γ-aminobutyric acid) is challenging due to low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and spectral overlap. We investigate and validate deep learning for quantifying complex, low-SNR, overlapping signals from MEGA-PRESS spectra, devise a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a Y-shaped autoencoder (YAE), and select the best models via Bayesian optimisation on 10,000 simulated spectra from slice-profile-aware MEGA-PRESS simulations. The selected models are trained on 100,000 simulated spectra. We validate their performance on 144 spectra from 112 experimental phantoms containing five metabolites of interest (GABA, Glu, Gln, NAA, Cr) with known ground truth concentrations across solution and gel series acquired at 3 T under varied bandwidths and implementations. These models are further assessed against the widely used LCModel quantification tool. On simulations, both models achieve near-perfect agreement (small MAEs; regression slopes ≈ 1.00, R2 ≈ 1.00). On experimental phantom data, errors initially increased substantially. However, modelling variable linewidths in the training data significantly reduced this gap. The best augmented deep learning models achieved a mean MAE for GABA over all phantom spectra of 0.151 (YAE) and 0.160 (FCNN) in max-normalised relative concentrations, outperforming the conventional baseline LCModel (0.220). A sim-to-real gap remains, but physics-informed data augmentation substantially reduced it. Phantom ground truth is needed to judge whether a method will perform reliably on real data.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了两种深度学习模型（CNN和YAE）用于从MEGA-PRESS磁共振波谱中量化低浓度代谢物（如GABA），通过贝叶斯优化选择最佳模型，在模拟数据上表现完美，在实验体模数据上通过线宽增强训练显著提升了性能，优于传统LCModel方法。
AI.research_question: 深度学习模型能否有效量化MEGA-PRESS磁共振波谱中低信噪比、重叠的低浓度代谢物信号（如GABA）？
AI.motivation: 磁共振波谱（MRS）可用于体内代谢物定量，但量化低浓度代谢物如GABA具有挑战性，因为信噪比低且光谱重叠严重。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN）和Y形自编码器（YAE）架构；贝叶斯优化用于模型选择；物理信息数据增强方法。
AI.method: 1. 开发CNN和YAE模型；2. 使用贝叶斯优化在10,000个模拟光谱上选择最佳模型；3. 在100,000个模拟光谱上训练选定模型；4. 在144个实验体模光谱上验证（112个体模，包含GABA、Glu、Gln、NAA、Cr五种代谢物）；5. 与广泛使用的LCModel工具进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. 在模拟数据上，两种模型都达到近乎完美的性能（MAE小，回归斜率≈1.00，R2≈1.00）；2. 在实验体模数据上，误差最初显著增加；3. 通过在训练数据中建模可变线宽，显著缩小了模拟与现实的差距；4. 最佳增强深度学习模型在GABA量化上的平均MAE为0.151（YAE）和0.160（FCNN），优于LCModel（0.220）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证明了深度学习在量化复杂、低信噪比、重叠MRS信号方面的有效性；2. 展示了物理信息数据增强（如可变线宽建模）对缩小模拟与现实差距的重要性；3. 为MRS代谢物量化提供了新的深度学习框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了优于传统LCModel的深度学习量化工具；2. 为神经疾病和癌症等疾病的生物标志物估计提供了更准确的代谢物量化方法；3. 强调了使用体模真实值验证方法在实际数据上可靠性的必要性。

reference: International Finance Discussion Paper No. 1435
title: Risk in a Data-Rich Model
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Queen Mary, University of London and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Risk in a Data-Rich Model

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We characterize asymmetric tail risk across over one hundred U.S. macroeconomic and financial variables using a dynamic factor model with stochastic volatility. The model unifies growth-at-risk, inflation-at-risk, and sectoral heterogeneity through common factors whose volatility responds endogenously to shocks, combined with heterogeneous factor loadings. We find that asymmetric tail risk is pervasive and heterogeneous: some sectors exhibit severe asymmetry while others show minimal asymmetry, with variation across activity, price, and financial variables. The framework disentangles supply- and demand-driven tail risk dynamics, revealing how the balance of risks shifts across episodes, and identifies where vulnerabilities concentrate across the economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用带有随机波动的动态因子模型，分析了100多个美国宏观经济和金融变量的不对称尾部风险，发现尾部风险普遍存在且具有异质性，不同部门表现出不同程度的尾部风险不对称性。
AI.research_question: 美国宏观经济和金融变量的不对称尾部风险特征是什么？如何通过动态因子模型统一分析增长风险、通胀风险和部门异质性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对宏观经济和金融变量不对称尾部风险的系统性分析，需要开发一个能够统一分析增长风险、通胀风险和部门异质性的框架，以更好地理解经济脆弱性的分布和动态变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态因子模型理论，结合随机波动性，构建了一个能够统一分析增长风险、通胀风险和部门异质性的理论框架。该框架通过共同因子（其波动性对内生冲击做出响应）和异质性因子载荷来捕捉经济系统的复杂动态。
AI.method: 使用带有随机波动的动态因子模型，分析了100多个美国宏观经济和金融变量。模型通过共同因子（其波动性对内生冲击做出响应）和异质性因子载荷来统一分析增长风险、通胀风险和部门异质性。
AI.findings: 研究发现不对称尾部风险普遍存在且具有异质性：一些部门表现出严重的尾部风险不对称性，而其他部门则显示出最小的不对称性，这种变化在活动、价格和金融变量中都有体现。框架能够区分供给驱动和需求驱动的尾部风险动态，揭示风险平衡在不同时期如何变化，并识别经济中脆弱性集中的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的动态因子模型框架，能够同时分析增长风险、通胀风险和部门异质性；发展了能够区分供给驱动和需求驱动尾部风险动态的理论方法；为理解经济脆弱性的分布和动态变化提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别经济脆弱性集中领域的工具；帮助理解不同经济部门的风险暴露差异；能够监测风险平衡在不同时期的变化，为宏观经济风险管理提供决策支持；有助于预测和防范系统性风险。

title: Optimized Bioresource Valorization: Geopedological Mapping of High-value Glucomannan and Anti-nutritional Cyanide in Amorphophallus Muelleri Blume across Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia
affiliations: University of Muhammadiyah Malang, University of Muhammadiyah Malang, University of Muhammadiyah Malang, University of Muhammadiyah Malang, Universitas Islam Madura and Universitas Muhammadiyah Malang

detail.title: Optimized Bioresource Valorization: Geopedological Mapping of High-value Glucomannan and Anti-nutritional Cyanide in Amorphophallus Muelleri Blume across Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors reported no declarations of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval and consent to participate As no endangered or legally protected species were used in this study, the need for a study permit did not apply to this study. Moreover, the study did not involve humans or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this study.

detail.abstract: The escalating global demand for functional ingredients necessitates the strategic optimization of high-value biopolymer sources, such as glucomannan derived from porang (Amorphophallus muelleri Blume). This study conducted a comprehensive comparative analysis of a single porang landrace harvested from seven distinct agroecological districts (P1-P7) across Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia, to identify the optimal cultivation zone for industrial-quality tubers. Proximate, carbohydrate (NFE, starch), glucomannan, and anti-nutritional cyanide (HCN) contents were determined. Results revealed significant environmental sensitivity, particularly in the primary commercial and safety determinants. The concentration of the target biopolymer, glucomannan, exhibited high variability (51.47% to 69.09%), peaking decisively in the P6 district (69.09%). This superior yield was critically associated with the latosol/lithosol soil type found in a hill zone (120 m elevation), suggesting that well-drained, moderately stressed pedological conditions favor maximal polysaccharide synthesis. Concurrently, while anti-nutritional HCN content varied (32.17 ppm to 86.12 ppm), the level in the P6 sample (42.86 ppm) remains easily mitigated by standard processing, with the economic benefit of the high glucomannan content overwhelmingly justifying the minor detoxification cost. Furthermore, P7 yielded the highest structural components, recording peak crude protein (8.85%) and ash (7.57%), demonstrating the region's diverse capacity for producing nutritionally dense tubers. This research confirms that specific geopedological characteristics of the P6 district oder a robust ecological niche for maximizing the industrial quality of porang, providing an empirical basis for targeted agricultural investment and sustainable policy recommendations to enhance Indonesia's global commodity competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较印度尼西亚东南苏拉威西七个不同农业生态区的单一魔芋品种，确定了P6地区（海拔120米的红壤/石质土丘陵区）为工业级魔芋块茎最佳种植区，其葡甘露聚糖含量最高（69.09%），抗营养氰化物含量适中（42.86 ppm），经济价值显著。
AI.research_question: 如何确定印度尼西亚东南苏拉威西地区最佳魔芋种植区，以生产具有工业品质的块茎？
AI.motivation: 全球对功能性成分需求不断增长，需要优化高价值生物聚合物来源（如魔芋葡甘露聚糖）的生产策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境敏感性理论、农业生态学、土壤类型与作物品质关系理论、生物聚合物合成优化理论。
AI.method: 对来自七个不同农业生态区（P1-P7）的单一魔芋品种进行综合比较分析，测定近似成分、碳水化合物（NFE、淀粉）、葡甘露聚糖和抗营养氰化物（HCN）含量。
AI.findings: 1. 葡甘露聚糖含量在51.47%至69.09%之间变化，P6地区最高（69.09%）；2. P6地区的优势与海拔120米的丘陵区红壤/石质土类型相关；3. 抗营养HCN含量在32.17 ppm至86.12 ppm之间变化，P6样本为42.86 ppm，可通过标准加工轻松降低；4. P7地区产生最高的结构成分，粗蛋白（8.85%）和灰分（7.57%）含量最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 证实了特定地理土壤特征（红壤/石质土、排水良好、适度胁迫的土壤条件）有利于最大化多糖合成；2. 为环境敏感性对商业和安全决定因素的影响提供了实证证据；3. 建立了土壤类型与魔芋工业品质之间的关联理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 确定了P6地区为魔芋工业种植的最佳区域；2. 为有针对性的农业投资提供了实证基础；3. 为可持续政策建议提供了依据，以增强印度尼西亚全球商品竞争力；4. 证明了高葡甘露聚糖含量的经济效益远超过抗营养物质的轻微解毒成本。

title: In Our Fara Era: Modernizing the Foreign Agents Registration Act
affiliations: Chapman University Fowler School of Law

detail.title: In Our Fara Era: Modernizing the Foreign Agents Registration Act

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflicts of interest and no personal or financial relationships that could have or could be perceived as influencing this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by a summer research grant from Chapman University.

detail.abstract:
Originally enacted in 1938 to counter Nazi propaganda, the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) has evolved from a seldom -used transparency tool into a primary instrument of national security enforcement. This revitalization has exposed a critical structural paradox: FARA is simultaneously too broad to protect fundamental liberties and too weak to deter sophisticated foreign subversion. This Article argues that FARA’s overly broad definition of agency and vague exceptions created a standard ripe for political weaponization. As the Supreme Court continues to narrow federal bribery and corruption statutes, the resulting "enforcement vacuum" has rendered FARA a “catchall” statute to address foreign influence operations, but with insufficient civil remedies to actually make the law effective.

The urgency of reform is underscored by recent executive directives targeting domestic non-profits and the global proliferation of "FARA-style" laws used by autocratic regimes to suppress dissent. This Article proposes a dual-track modernization: first, narrowing the definition of "agency" and clarifying exemptions to safeguard First Amendment activities; and second, introducing robust civil enforcement mechanisms—such as the disgorgement of unjust enrichment—to address non-willful violations. By distinguishing between intentional subversion and negligent conduct, these reforms ensure FARA serves its protective purpose without becoming a blueprint for state-sponsored harassment.

AI.tldr: 《外国代理人登记法》（FARA）从鲜少使用的透明度工具演变为国家安全执法的主要手段，但其过于宽泛的代理定义和模糊的例外条款使其既无法有效保护基本自由，又不足以威慑复杂的外国颠覆活动。文章提出双重改革路径：缩小代理定义范围以保护第一修正案活动，同时引入强有力的民事执法机制来应对非故意违规。
AI.research_question: FARA如何从透明度工具演变为国家安全执法手段？其结构性矛盾是什么？如何改革FARA以平衡国家安全与公民自由保护？
AI.motivation: FARA的复兴暴露了其结构性矛盾：既过于宽泛无法保护基本自由，又过于薄弱无法威慑复杂的外国颠覆活动。最高法院不断缩小联邦贿赂和腐败法规的范围，导致"执法真空"，使FARA成为解决外国影响行动的"全能法规"，但缺乏有效的民事救济措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家安全与公民自由平衡理论；法规演变与适应性理论；执法工具与公民权利保护框架；外国影响与国内政治干预理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析；历史演变分析；案例研究；比较法分析（FARA式法律在全球的扩散）；政策建议分析。
AI.findings: FARA的代理定义过于宽泛，例外条款模糊，容易被政治武器化。最高法院缩小腐败法规范围导致执法真空，使FARA成为解决外国影响的主要工具但效果有限。全球专制政权正在利用"FARA式"法律压制异议。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了FARA的结构性矛盾理论框架；分析了国家安全法规演变的动态过程；建立了外国影响法规与公民自由保护的平衡模型；贡献了法规武器化的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出双重改革方案：1) 缩小代理定义范围，明确豁免条款以保护第一修正案活动；2) 引入强有力的民事执法机制（如不当得利返还）处理非故意违规。区分故意颠覆与过失行为，确保FARA实现保护目的而不成为国家支持的骚扰工具。

title:
The Geometry of Alpha 

Manifold Learning, Topological Data Analysis, and Non-Linear Factor Structures in Global Equity Markets
affiliations: Independent Analyst

detail.title:
The Geometry of Alpha 

Manifold Learning, Topological Data Analysis, and Non-Linear Factor Structures in Global Equity Markets
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the application of non-linear geometric and topological methods to the problem of equity return prediction and factor model construction. We argue that the linear factor paradigminitiated by Sharpe (1964) and extended through Fama and French (1993, 2015) and Carhart (1997)-is fundamentally inadequate to capture the rich curvature of return-generating processes in modern global equity markets. Drawing on differential geometry, manifold learning theory, and topological data analysis (TDA), we propose a Geometric Deep Learning (GDL) framework for alpha generation that operates directly on the intrinsic geometry of return spaces. Empirically, we apply the framework to a universe of 3,200 global equities across 47 markets over the period 2010-2024, demonstrating that non-linear factor representations extracted via graph neural networks (GNNs) and topological persistence diagrams achieve an annualized out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.52-a 162% improvement over linear factor benchmarks. We further develop a Hidden Markov Model (HMM) regime detection system that conditions factor exposures on latent market states, reducing maximum drawdown by 67% relative to regime-naive approaches. The paper also provides a comprehensive treatment of epistemic risks inherent in machine learning-based alpha generation-including distributional shift, model overfitting, and data snooping-and proposes a Multilayered Model Validation Framework (MMVF) aligned with the Federal Reserve's SR 11-7 supervisory guidance. Our findings have direct implications for the construction of systematic equity strategies, the design of factor-based investment products, and the regulatory governance of algorithmic portfolio management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于非线性几何和拓扑方法的股票收益预测和因子模型构建框架，通过几何深度学习(GDL)直接从收益空间的内在几何结构中提取非线性因子表示，相比传统线性因子模型实现了162%的夏普比率提升，并开发了基于隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)的市场状态识别系统来降低回撤风险。
AI.research_question: 如何应用非线性几何和拓扑方法来改进股票收益预测和因子模型构建，以克服传统线性因子模型的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统线性因子模型（如Sharpe、Fama-French、Carhart模型）无法捕捉现代全球股票市场中收益生成过程的复杂非线性结构，需要更先进的数学工具来建模收益空间的内在几何特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微分几何、流形学习理论、拓扑数据分析(TDA)、几何深度学习(GDL)、图神经网络(GNNs)、隐马尔可夫模型(HMM)
AI.method: 提出几何深度学习(GDL)框架，应用于2010-2024年期间47个市场的3200只全球股票，使用图神经网络(GNNs)和拓扑持续性图提取非线性因子表示，开发HMM市场状态识别系统，并建立多层模型验证框架(MMVF)来管理机器学习风险。
AI.findings: 非线性因子表示实现了年化样本外夏普比率1.52，相比线性因子基准提升了162%；HMM市场状态识别系统将最大回撤降低了67%；证明了非线性几何方法在股票收益预测中的显著优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将微分几何、流形学习和拓扑数据分析引入金融建模领域，提出了基于几何深度学习的因子模型新范式，挑战了传统线性因子模型的局限性，为金融时间序列分析提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为系统性股票策略构建、因子投资产品设计提供了新的技术框架；提出的多层模型验证框架(MMVF)符合美联储SR 11-7监管指引，有助于算法投资组合管理的监管治理；实证结果显示了显著的风险调整后收益提升。

title: The Rise of AI (Agents):  Could Artificial Intelligence Eventually Destroy the Workplace?
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt - Faculty of Law
