detail.abstract: The United States’ energy strategy must bridge economic policy and geopolitical power, while offering a calibrated response to climate change. While the country experienced two decades of relatively constant energy consumption, it now faces a surge in power demand driven by artificial intelligence, domestic manufacturing, and continued electrification. These developments challenge an already-constrained domestic electricity grid with limited spare capacity. This paper argues that a renewed strategy should motivate new action to increase energy supply, build infrastructure, and approach greenhouse-gas emissions reductions with competition in mind. Appropriate actions include expanding the development and deployment of nuclear energy, investing in improvements to the high-voltage interstate transmission system, building new natural-gas plants capable of being later retrofitted with carbon capture equipment, and establishing rigorous carbon-accounting standards.

AI.tldr: 美国能源战略需平衡经济政策与地缘政治力量，应对AI、制造业和电气化带来的电力需求激增，通过发展核能、升级电网、建设可改造的天然气电厂和建立碳核算标准来增加能源供应和基础设施。
AI.research_question: 面对AI、制造业和电气化带来的电力需求激增，美国应如何制定能源战略来平衡经济政策、地缘政治和气候变化应对？
AI.motivation: 美国经历了二十年相对稳定的能源消费后，现在面临由人工智能、国内制造业和持续电气化驱动的电力需求激增，这对已经受限的国内电网构成挑战，需要新的能源战略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源战略的三重框架：经济政策、地缘政治力量和气候变化应对的平衡；竞争性减排方法；能源安全与基础设施发展的整合。
AI.method: 政策分析框架，基于当前能源消费趋势、电网容量限制和新兴需求驱动因素的分析，提出战略建议。
AI.findings: 美国需要采取具体行动：1）扩大核能发展和部署；2）投资高压州际输电系统改进；3）建设可后期改造碳捕集设备的天然气电厂；4）建立严格的碳核算标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"竞争性减排"的能源战略框架，强调在增加能源供应和基础设施的同时，以竞争为导向处理温室气体减排。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的行动方案：核能扩张、电网升级、天然气电厂的可改造设计、碳核算标准制定，以应对电力需求激增和电网约束的挑战。

detail.abstract: Prediction products in the form of binary options that settle based on the occurrence of discrete events have experienced a rapid expansion on U.S. derivatives exchanges. Once limited to conventional economic variables such as weather or macroeconomic indicators, these products now encompass elections, sporting events, and elements of popular culture. This overview provides an account of the regulatory challenges posed by this expansion, focusing on (a) jurisdictional issues between gambling and derivatives activity, (b) manipulation, and (c) insider trading.

AI.tldr: 本文概述了美国衍生品交易所中基于离散事件结算的二元期权预测产品的快速扩张及其带来的监管挑战，重点关注赌博与衍生品活动的管辖权问题、操纵市场和内幕交易三个核心问题。
AI.research_question: 二元期权预测产品从传统经济变量扩展到选举、体育赛事和流行文化等领域，这种扩张带来了哪些监管挑战？
AI.motivation: 预测产品（二元期权）在美国衍生品交易所快速扩张，从传统的天气、宏观经济指标扩展到选举、体育赛事和流行文化等领域，这种扩张带来了新的监管挑战需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融监管理论、衍生品市场监管框架、赌博与衍生品活动的法律区分理论、市场操纵和内幕交易监管理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与监管分析，通过对现有监管框架、法律条文和案例的系统梳理，识别和分析预测产品扩张带来的监管挑战。
AI.findings: 预测产品的扩张主要带来三个核心监管挑战：1）赌博活动与衍生品活动的管辖权划分问题；2）市场操纵风险；3）内幕交易问题。这些挑战需要监管部门重新审视现有监管框架的适用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于将传统衍生品监管理论扩展到新兴预测产品领域，提出了赌博与衍生品活动边界模糊的理论问题，为金融创新与监管平衡提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了识别和应对预测产品扩张带来的监管挑战的框架，帮助制定更有效的监管政策，保护投资者利益，维护市场完整性，同时促进金融创新。

title: Tractable Identification of Strategic Network Formation Models with Unobserved Heterogeneity
affiliations: , University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Tractable Identification of Strategic Network Formation Models with Unobserved Heterogeneity
detail.abstract: We develop a tractable identification approach for strategic network formation models with both strategic link interdependence and individual unobserved heterogeneity (fixed effects). The key challenge is that endogenous network statistics (e.g. number of common friends) enter the link formation equation, while the mapping from model primitives to equilibrium network structure is generally intractable. Our approach sidesteps this difficulty using a "bounding-by-c" technique that treats endogenous covariates as random variables and exploits monotonicity restrictions to obtain identifying information. We derive a system of identifying restrictions based on subnetwork configurations: tetrad-based restrictions that completely eliminate all individual fixed effects, triad-based restrictions that partially difference out fixed effects, and general weighted cycle-based restrictions, along with point identification results. Preliminary simulations show that our approach can deliver informative bounds on the structural parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可处理的识别方法，用于具有战略链接相互依赖性和个体不可观测异质性（固定效应）的战略网络形成模型。该方法使用"bounding-by-c"技术，将内生协变量视为随机变量，并利用单调性限制来获取识别信息。
AI.research_question: 如何在具有战略链接相互依赖性和个体固定效应的网络形成模型中识别结构参数？
AI.motivation: 战略网络形成模型中的关键挑战是内生网络统计量（如共同朋友数量）进入链接形成方程，而从模型原语到均衡网络结构的映射通常难以处理。现有方法难以同时处理战略相互依赖性和个体异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略网络形成模型、固定效应模型、识别理论、网络计量经济学
AI.method: 使用"bounding-by-c"技术，将内生协变量视为随机变量，利用单调性限制。基于子网络配置推导识别限制：完全消除所有个体固定效应的四元组限制、部分差分固定效应的三元组限制，以及一般加权循环限制。
AI.findings: 推导了基于子网络配置的识别限制系统，包括点识别结果。初步模拟表明该方法可以为结构参数提供信息性边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 为具有战略相互依赖性和个体固定效应的网络形成模型提供了新的识别方法，克服了传统方法难以处理内生网络统计量的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究人员提供了实用的识别工具，可以应用于社交网络、经济网络等实际网络形成分析，即使存在复杂的战略互动和个体异质性。

title: Innovative Entrepreneurs Replace Despair with Hope

detail.title: Innovative Entrepreneurs Replace Despair with Hope

declarations.funderStatement: An early version received an award in the Charles Koch Institute’s concept paper competition organized by Lenore Ealy.

detail.abstract: In the bourgeoise deal the worst off do not begrudge the prosperity of the well off because they hope eventually to earn their own prosperity.  But that hope wavered when regulations limited the ability of innovative entrepreneurs to create new jobs for the worst off.  If deregulated, the innovative entrepreneurs can again create a labor market where a low-skilled worker can usually find a job that gives him hope for a better future.  I reject the common belief that new technology and outsourcing are the causes of the dearth of jobs for the worst off.  Many examples show that innovative entrepreneurs have the desire and ability to find productive uses for the unused, both unused natural resources and unused labor.  When left unbound, innovative entrepreneurs have the means and motivation to find productive employment for unused resources, employing milkweed to insulate parkas or employing desperate small farmers as steel workers to run a new kind of steel mill.  Innovative entrepreneur Ken Iverson at Nucor provides a proof-of-concept that the worst off can benefit when lighter regulation allows innovative entrepreneurs to create more jobs.  Redundant labor markets once flourished before innovative entrepreneurs were heavily regulated.  But several studies show that regulations now restrict the innovative entrepreneur's ability to find uses for the unused.  Beyond deregulating innovative entrepreneurs, the prospects of the worst off also would benefit from the worst off embracing a work ethic, and from deregulation of healthcare.  Some evidence suggests an increasing political openness to systematic deregulation; indicating that the previously politically infeasible, may be becoming feasible.  I conclude by expressing rational optimism, based on past episodes of entrepreneurial liberation, that the worst off will regain hope when innovators are freed.

AI.tldr: 本文认为过度监管限制了创新企业家的就业创造能力，导致底层劳动者失去希望。通过放松监管，让创新企业家自由发挥，可以创造更多就业机会，改善底层劳动者的处境。
AI.research_question: 监管如何限制创新企业家为底层劳动者创造就业机会的能力？放松监管能否恢复底层劳动者对未来繁荣的希望？
AI.motivation: 底层劳动者原本不嫉妒富裕阶层，因为他们希望通过努力工作获得自己的繁荣。但当监管限制了创新企业家创造新就业机会的能力时，这种希望动摇了。需要探讨如何恢复这种希望。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新企业家理论，强调企业家在发现未利用资源（包括劳动力）价值方面的作用。批判了将就业不足归因于新技术和外包的常见观点。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，以Nucor公司的Ken Iverson为例作为概念验证，并结合历史比较分析（监管前后劳动力市场变化）和现有研究证据。
AI.findings: 1. 创新企业家有能力和意愿为未利用资源（包括劳动力）找到生产性用途；2. 监管限制了企业家创造就业的能力；3. 放松监管可以恢复劳动力市场的活力；4. 底层劳动者还需要工作伦理和医疗保健放松监管的配合。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于就业不足的传统解释（技术变革和外包），提出了监管约束创新企业家能力的理论框架，强调企业家在创造就业和资源利用中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供放松监管以促进就业的具体建议；2. 为企业家争取更自由的经营环境提供理论支持；3. 为底层劳动者指出通过工作伦理和制度改善获得希望的具体路径。

title: Rethinking Intellectual Property: A Five-Part Architecture for Managing Knowledge Across Contexts"
affiliations: Southern Cross University - Faculty of Health

detail.title: Rethinking Intellectual Property: A Five-Part Architecture for Managing Knowledge Across Contexts"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of HealthWorX Futures, a health intelligence consultancy. The analytical frameworks discussed in this paper include examples drawn from the author's professional experience as an independent researcher and consultant. The author declares no financial relationships with any organisations that could inappropriately influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper presents theoretical, analytical, and policy argument. It does not report empirical research involving human participants, personal data, or biological material. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently, without institutional support or sponsorship.

detail.abstract: Contemporary intellectual property (IP) systems are built on a narrow conceptualisation of knowledge as discrete, codifiable outputs that can be owned, protected, and transferred. While effective in domains where knowledge can be stabilised into artefacts, this model does not generalise across the full spectrum of contemporary research and innovation-particularly in interdisciplinary, practice-based, and socially-oriented fields. The Ambitious Australia Report (2025) identifies university IP policy as overly complex, risk-averse, and commercially disconnected, but does not provide a diagnostic framework for reform. This paper responds directly to that gap. I introduce the proposition that IP systems are downstream expressions of epistemic architecture: they determine not only how knowledge is owned, but which forms of knowledge can be recognised, stabilised, and valued. Drawing on theories of tacit and embodied knowledge (Polanyi, 1966; Nonaka and Takeuchi, 1995; Collins, 2012), appropriability regimes (Teece, 1986), and the political economy of academic knowledge production (Slaughter and Rhoades, 2009), I propose a five-part analytical architecture-Type, Locus, Flow, Intent, Instrument-the TLFII framework. I show that misalignment across any of these five dimensions predicts specific forms of IP failure. The paper introduces a typology of knowledge migration pathways, a strategic intent matrix, and a governance proposition. It identifies a structural market failure-the private developer / public buyer asymmetry-for which current IP frameworks provide no adequate instrument, and proposes a performing rights licensing model, adapted from the creative industries, as a structural solution.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判当前知识产权体系过于狭隘，仅关注可编码的知识产出，无法适应跨学科、实践导向和社会导向的研究领域。作者提出TLFII分析框架（类型、场所、流动、意图、工具），揭示知识产权失败的根本原因，并提出基于创意产业的表演权许可模式作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何诊断和改革当前知识产权体系，使其能够更好地识别、稳定和评估跨学科、实践导向和社会导向领域的知识形式？
AI.motivation: 《雄心勃勃的澳大利亚报告（2025）》指出大学知识产权政策过于复杂、风险规避且与商业脱节，但缺乏改革的分析框架。当前知识产权体系基于狭隘的知识概念化，无法适应现代研究和创新的多样性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 隐性知识和具身知识理论（Polanyi, 1966; Nonaka and Takeuchi, 1995; Collins, 2012）
2. 可占用性制度理论（Teece, 1986）
3. 学术知识生产的政治经济学（Slaughter and Rhoades, 2009）
AI.method: 提出TLFII分析框架（类型、场所、流动、意图、工具），包括知识迁移路径类型学、战略意图矩阵和治理命题。通过框架分析揭示知识产权失败的结构性原因。
AI.findings:
1. 知识产权体系是认识论架构的下游表达
2. 五个维度（TLFII）中的任何不匹配都会导致特定形式的知识产权失败
3. 存在结构性市场失灵（私人开发者/公共购买者不对称），当前知识产权框架无法提供适当工具
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出TLFII分析框架，将知识产权体系与认识论架构联系起来
2. 建立知识迁移路径类型学
3. 提出战略意图矩阵，分析知识产权战略的不同维度
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出表演权许可模式（借鉴创意产业）作为解决结构性市场失灵的方案
2. 为知识产权政策改革提供诊断框架
3. 为跨学科、实践导向和社会导向研究的知识产权管理提供实用指导

title: "Private" Governance Is Actually a Club Good
affiliations: University of New Hampshire Franklin Pierce School of Law

detail.title: "Private" Governance Is Actually a Club Good
detail.abstract: Network governance is a club good. Courts that displace a network’s authority to ostracize rule-breakers weaken the excludability that makes governance valuable to members and non-members alike. When the ostracism mechanism loses credibility, members defect from governance obligations, governance quality declines, and the positive externalities governance creates for non-members disappear. Courts should therefore recognize doctrines that defer to network decisions as implicit Pigouvian subsidies that reduce governance costs and help prevent the undersupply of socially valuable governance.

AI.tldr: 网络治理是一种俱乐部产品。法院若取代网络驱逐违规者的权威，会削弱排他性，从而降低治理对成员和非成员的价值。当驱逐机制失去可信度时，成员会逃避治理义务，治理质量下降，治理为非成员创造的积极外部性也会消失。因此，法院应承认尊重网络决策的原则是隐含的庇古补贴，可降低治理成本，防止对社会有价值的治理供给不足。
AI.research_question: 法院干预如何影响网络治理的有效性？具体而言，当法院取代网络驱逐违规者的权威时，会对治理质量和社会价值产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 网络治理作为一种俱乐部产品，通过排他性机制（如驱逐违规者）维持治理质量。然而，法院干预可能削弱这种排他性，导致治理失效，进而影响成员和非成员的福利。需要理解法院干预对网络治理的负面影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 俱乐部产品理论、排他性机制、庇古补贴理论、网络治理理论、外部性理论
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究，基于俱乐部产品理论和外部性理论构建分析框架，探讨法院干预对网络治理排他性机制的影响路径
AI.findings: 1. 法院取代网络驱逐权威会削弱治理的排他性；2. 驱逐机制失去可信度导致成员逃避治理义务；3. 治理质量下降，为非成员创造的积极外部性消失；4. 法院尊重网络决策的原则可视为隐含的庇古补贴，降低治理成本
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将网络治理概念化为俱乐部产品；2. 提出法院干预削弱排他性的理论机制；3. 将司法尊重原则重新解释为隐含的庇古补贴；4. 为网络治理有效性提供新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法院提供政策建议：应尊重网络自治决策；2. 帮助网络管理者理解司法干预的风险；3. 为政策制定者提供防止治理供给不足的解决方案；4. 促进网络治理与社会福利的协调

title: Crosstagion: The GENIUS Act, CLARITY, and the OCC-CFTC-SEC Gap in Bidirectional Stablecoin Contagion
affiliations: University of New Hampshire Franklin Pierce School of Law

detail.title: Crosstagion: The GENIUS Act, CLARITY, and the OCC-CFTC-SEC Gap in Bidirectional Stablecoin Contagion
detail.abstract: The GENIUS Act's prudential framework protects against systemic risk that flows in one direction: from stablecoin failure into traditional banking risk. The empirical record of crosstagion, the bidirectional contagion between traditional finance and decentralized finance, demonstrates that the transmission channel runs the other way as well. When traditional financial stress destabilizes payment stablecoin reserves, as occurred when Silicon Valley Bank's failure briefly unpegged USD Coin in March 2023, the cascade into decentralized markets falls into a jurisdictional gap that neither GENIUS nor the CLARITY Act resolves. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency owns the stablecoin issuer; the Commodity Futures Trading Commission owns the derivative markets where the cascade lands; and a depegged stablecoin may simultaneously fall under the Securities and Exchange Commission's jurisdiction as a potential investment contract under the Howey test. No statute allocates liability or mandates coordination among these three agencies when the transmission crosses their respective boundaries, and no mechanism exists for assigning jurisdictional primacy before all three assert competing claims. DAO governance failure compounds the problem by creating a distinct transmission mechanism operating at blockchain speed, with no identifiable counterparty and no circuit breaker. This Article argues that closing the crosstagion gap requires not new prudential requirements but a designated tri-agency coordination mechanism, triggered by observable stress indicators, that assigns jurisdictional primacy and activates a classification standstill before a crisis rather than after.

AI.tldr: 该文指出GENIUS法案的审慎框架仅单向防范稳定币失败向传统银行的风险传导，但实证显示双向传染（crosstagion）同样存在。当传统金融压力（如硅谷银行倒闭）导致稳定币脱锚时，风险会传导至去中心化市场，而现有监管框架存在管辖权空白，三大机构（OCC、CFTC、SEC）缺乏协调机制。文章主张建立三机构协调机制而非新的审慎要求。
AI.research_question: 如何解决传统金融与去中心化金融之间双向传染风险（crosstagion）的监管管辖权空白问题？
AI.motivation: GENIUS法案仅关注稳定币失败向传统银行的单向风险传导，但2023年3月硅谷银行倒闭导致USDC脱锚事件表明，传统金融压力同样会传导至去中心化市场，而现有监管框架（GENIUS和CLARITY法案）未能解决这一双向传染风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、监管管辖权理论、金融传染理论、去中心化自治组织（DAO）治理理论
AI.method: 实证分析（基于硅谷银行倒闭导致USDC脱锚的案例）、法律分析（分析GENIUS法案、CLARITY法案及OCC、CFTC、SEC的管辖权）、监管框架比较分析
AI.findings: 1. 传统金融压力可通过稳定币储备传导至去中心化市场；2. 现有监管存在三机构（OCC、CFTC、SEC）管辖权重叠与空白；3. DAO治理失败会以区块链速度加速风险传导；4. 缺乏事前协调机制和管辖权优先分配机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"crosstagion"（双向传染）概念，扩展了金融传染理论；发展了监管协调理论，强调事前机制而非事后应对；为DAO治理与系统性风险关联提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议建立三机构（OCC、CFTC、SEC）协调机制；2. 提出基于可观测压力指标的触发机制；3. 主张危机前而非危机后激活分类暂停；4. 为监管改革提供具体政策建议

reference: In B. Ghosh, K. K. Sarkar, & B. Chakrabortty (Eds.), Corruption: Origin, development and consequences. Kunal Books. ISBN 978-93-6389-298-9
title: Mapping Political Corruption in West Bengal: Thematic Analysis of a Decade, 2010-2020
affiliations: Jadavpur University

detail.title: Mapping Political Corruption in West Bengal: Thematic Analysis of a Decade, 2010-2020

publicationDetails.detailsText: In B. Ghosh, K. K. Sarkar, & B. Chakrabortty (Eds.), Corruption: Origin, development and consequences. Kunal Books. ISBN 978-93-6389-298-9

detail.abstract: This study points out a thematic analysis of political corruption in West Bengal from 2010 to 2020, a decade of scandals and scams from the 34-year Left Front (CPI-M) regime to the All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) administration. This research maps the evolution of corruption from an institutionalised, party-centric model to a more personalised, transactional, and populist form. Based on a qualitative research method and through analysis of major scandals, including the Saradha and Rose Valley Ponzi schemes, the Narada sting operation, and systemic rackets in illegal coal mining and cattle smuggling. The main research question of this study is: During the big political shift in West Bengal from 2010 to 2020, what did corruption by politicians actually look like, what were the most common types of scams, and how exactly did they execute them? The main objectives of this study are 1) to systematically document and classify the major incidents of political corruption reported in West Bengal between 2010 and 2020. 2) To find out the various impacts of corruption on West Bengal's governance, economic development, public trust, and political landscape. The main findings of this study are: 1) the political economy of dejection, where socio-economic numbness created easy ground for fraudulent financial schemes that expanded on political guardianship. 2) The normalisation of corruption, where the TMC's populist welfarism created a public perception of bribery as a "necessary evil" for accessing state services, and a disconnect between corruption allegations and electoral outcomes. In conclusion, the corrupt system and untrustworthy political parties signify an undemocratic and petty way of politics in West Bengal.

AI.tldr: 本文对2010-2020年西孟加拉邦政治腐败进行了主题分析，揭示了从制度化的政党中心模式向个人化、交易型和民粹主义形式的演变，通过分析主要丑闻展示了腐败如何成为常态化的"必要之恶"。
AI.research_question: 在2010-2020年西孟加拉邦重大政治转型期间，政治家的腐败实际表现如何？最常见的骗局类型是什么？他们具体是如何执行的？
AI.motivation: 研究西孟加拉邦从34年左翼阵线(CPI-M)统治到全印草根国大党(TMC)执政期间腐败现象的演变，这一时期充满了丑闻和骗局，需要系统分析腐败模式的变化及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治腐败理论、制度腐败理论、民粹主义与腐败关系理论、政治经济学中的"绝望政治经济学"概念、腐败正常化理论。
AI.method: 定性研究方法，通过对主要丑闻的主题分析，包括Saradha和Rose Valley庞氏骗局、Narada秘密行动、非法煤矿开采和牛走私等系统性诈骗。
AI.findings: 1) "绝望政治经济学"：社会经济麻木为欺诈性金融计划创造了容易滋生的土壤，这些计划依赖政治庇护而扩张。2) 腐败正常化：TMC的民粹主义福利主义创造了公众将贿赂视为获取国家服务的"必要之恶"的认知，腐败指控与选举结果之间存在脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了从制度化政党中心腐败模式向个人化、交易型、民粹主义形式演变的腐败转型理论框架。2) 发展了"绝望政治经济学"概念，解释社会经济条件如何助长腐败。3) 深化了腐败正常化理论在民粹主义政治背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 系统记录了2010-2020年西孟加拉邦主要政治腐败事件并进行了分类。2) 揭示了腐败对西孟加拉邦治理、经济发展、公众信任和政治格局的各种影响。3) 为政策制定者提供了腐败演变模式的实际证据，有助于设计更有效的反腐败策略。

title: The Wrong Plaintiff: Contract Damages versus Network Expulsion and the Collapse of Distributed Governance
affiliations: University of New Hampshire Franklin Pierce School of Law

detail.title: The Wrong Plaintiff: Contract Damages versus Network Expulsion and the Collapse of Distributed Governance
detail.abstract:
Courts awarding standard contract remedies can destroy private network governance. In collectively governed trading networks, commercial cooperation often depends on the credible threat of ostracism. That threat is best understood as a club good: excludable because only members benefit from the network’s ability to sanction rule-breakers, and nonrivalrous because one member’s benefit from that enforcement capacity does not diminish another’s. Indeed, the threat often exhibits positive network effects: the larger the network, the greater the cost of exclusion and the stronger the deterrent.

Yet courts sometimes undermine a network’s power to ostracize by applying a doctrinal framework that identifies only the individual promisee as the injured party. When judicial intervention displaces the network’s authority to exclude violators, it converts collective exclusion from a property rule into a liability rule and degrades the club good into a public good. Making one obligee whole through expectation damages can therefore produce a net welfare loss by weakening the credibility of exclusion. A court’s effort to remedy a single breach may thus eliminate the incentive to maintain the network itself. Courts must recognize this mechanism to avoid collapsing valuable transactional networks.

AI.tldr: 法院适用标准合同救济可能破坏私人网络治理。在集体治理的交易网络中，商业合作依赖于可信的排斥威胁。这种威胁具有俱乐部商品特性：排他性（只有成员受益）和非竞争性（一成员受益不减少他人受益）。法院通过仅将个体承诺人视为受害方的法律框架，可能削弱网络排斥能力，将集体排斥从财产规则转为责任规则，将俱乐部商品降为公共商品，从而损害网络治理价值。
AI.research_question: 法院如何通过适用标准合同救济破坏私人交易网络的治理机制？
AI.motivation: 揭示法院干预可能无意中破坏有价值的交易网络治理机制，导致集体福利损失
AI.theoretical_framework: 俱乐部商品理论、网络治理理论、财产规则与责任规则理论、网络外部性理论
AI.method: 理论分析，结合法律经济学和网络治理理论框架
AI.findings: 1. 网络排斥威胁具有俱乐部商品特性（排他性、非竞争性、正网络外部性）；2. 法院仅关注个体承诺人损害网络集体治理能力；3. 司法干预将集体排斥从财产规则转为责任规则；4. 对单一违约的救济可能削弱整个网络的治理机制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将网络排斥威胁概念化为俱乐部商品；2. 揭示司法干预如何改变治理规则性质；3. 提出法院干预可能产生负外部性的理论机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警示法院在审理网络交易纠纷时需考虑集体治理影响；2. 为法院设计更合适的救济方式提供指导；3. 帮助网络参与者理解司法干预的风险

title: Institutional Stability and Adaptive Capacity: Measuring Systemic Strain in Decision Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher in Behavioral Science and Systems Psychology

detail.title: Institutional Stability and Adaptive Capacity: Measuring Systemic Strain in Decision Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies. This paper presents a conceptual analytical framework for observing decision dynamics and adaptive capacity in complex institutional systems. It does not propose policy interventions or governance reforms.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a condition-based approach to assessing institutional stability in advanced governance systems. It argues that institutions operating under sustained uncertainty exhibit identifiable patterns of systemic strain that affect decision behavior long before observable performance decline or formal malfunction. Rather than relying on crisis indicators, output metrics, or retrospective failure analysis, the paper focuses on adaptive capacity as the ability of decision systems to sustain responsibility-bearing action under cognitive and procedural load. By examining changes in decision latency, responsibility perception, and procedural mediation, the paper proposes an analytical framework for measuring institutional condition without normative judgment or reform agendas. The contribution lies in providing a diagnostic perspective suitable for institutional self-observation, regulatory reflection, and long-term resilience assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件的制度稳定性评估方法，关注在持续不确定性下决策系统的适应能力，而非危机指标或绩效下降。
AI.research_question: 如何在高级治理系统中评估制度稳定性？如何识别系统性压力对决策行为的影响，而不依赖危机指标或绩效下降？
AI.motivation: 传统制度评估方法依赖危机指标、产出指标或回顾性失败分析，无法在可观察的绩效下降或正式故障之前识别系统性压力模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于条件的制度稳定性理论，关注决策系统在认知和程序负荷下维持责任承担行动的能力（适应能力）。
AI.method: 通过考察决策延迟、责任感知和程序调解的变化，提出分析框架，测量制度状况而不涉及规范性判断或改革议程。
AI.findings: 在持续不确定性下运作的制度表现出可识别的系统性压力模式，这些模式在可观察的绩效下降之前就影响决策行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了制度稳定性的诊断视角，强调适应能力作为核心评估维度，为制度自我观察、监管反思和长期韧性评估提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度自我观察、监管反思和长期韧性评估提供实用诊断工具，帮助机构在危机发生前识别系统性压力。

title: Exclusive Inclusion: How University Governance Produces the Discrimination It Promises to Prevent
affiliations: University of New Hampshire Franklin Pierce School of Law

detail.title: Exclusive Inclusion: How University Governance Produces the Discrimination It Promises to Prevent
detail.abstract: Institutions publicly committed to "inclusive" can produce systematic identity-based exclusion as a structural output. This Essay introduces exclusive inclusion to name this condition: the governance state in which self-perpetuating boards, unenforceable fiduciary duties, and the absence of stakeholder standing create an accountability void that organized factions exploit to exclude disfavored identity groups. The mechanism is architectural, not attitudinal, and operates across identity categories: Women of Color in STEM, Black students at liberal arts colleges, conservative faculty, Jewish students, and students with disabilities all face exclusion through the same governance failures. Drawing on organizational theory and the author's prior work on "sovereign charities," this Essay offers a diagnostic tool, the disentanglement matrix, to separate protected individual expression from institutional identitybased exclusion. Three structural reforms follow: stakeholder standing modeled on corporate derivative suits, enforceable mission specificity, and an operational test for tax exemption adapted from hospital community benefit standards. Because exclusive inclusion is structural, governance reform benefits every affected constituency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"排他性包容"概念，指出表面上承诺包容的机构实际上通过治理结构产生系统性身份排斥，并提出三项结构性改革方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么公开承诺"包容"的机构会产生系统性身份排斥？如何通过治理改革解决这种结构性排斥？
AI.motivation: 许多机构公开宣称包容，但实际运作中却排斥特定身份群体，这种矛盾现象需要理论解释和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织理论、作者先前关于"主权慈善机构"的研究、排他性包容概念、解耦矩阵分析工具。
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究（STEM领域有色人种女性、文理学院黑人学生、保守派教师、犹太学生、残疾学生等）、治理结构分析。
AI.findings: 自我延续的董事会、不可执行的信托责任、利益相关者缺乏诉讼资格等治理失败创造了问责真空，有组织派系利用此真空排斥不受欢迎的身份群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"排他性包容"理论概念，开发"解耦矩阵"诊断工具，揭示治理结构而非态度是排斥机制的核心。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项结构性改革：基于公司派生诉讼的利益相关者诉讼资格、可执行的使命具体化、基于医院社区福利标准的免税操作测试。

title: The AI Implementation Paradox: Organizational Contradictions and the Emergence of the AI-Native Organization

detail.title: The AI Implementation Paradox: Organizational Contradictions and the Emergence of the AI-Native Organization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, personal, or professional conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human subjects, personal data collection, or experimental procedures. All sources used are publicly available.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming organizational decision-making, workforce structure, and operational workflows. However, its implementation introduces fundamental contradictions that challenge traditional management models. This paper develops a conceptual framework identifying nine core organizational contradictions arising from AI integration, including autonomy versus human oversight, efficiency versus trust, bias mitigation versus bias amplification, job displacement versus augmentation, and innovation speed versus governance stability. Drawing on empirical evidence from industry case studies, regulatory developments, and organizational research, the analysis demonstrates that AI is neither purely an automation tool nor purely an augmentation tool, but an organizational forcing function that reshapes the cognitive and structural architecture of work. The findings suggest that organizations treating AI as a plug-and-play efficiency tool often experience degraded trust, deskilling, and operational fragility, while organizations that redesign workflows, governance systems, and leadership roles around human-AI collaboration achieve sustainable performance gains. This paper introduces the concept of the "AI-native organization," defined as an organization structurally redesigned to integrate AI as an amplifier of human judgment rather than a replacement for human capability. The framework contributes to the emerging literature on AI governance, human-AI collaboration, and organizational transformation by providing a structured model for understanding the paradoxical effects of AI implementation.

AI.tldr: AI在组织中的应用既不是纯粹的自动化工具，也不是纯粹的增强工具，而是一种组织强制函数，重塑工作的认知和结构架构。组织若将AI视为即插即用的效率工具，往往会导致信任下降、技能退化和运营脆弱性；而围绕人机协作重新设计工作流程、治理系统和领导角色的组织则能实现可持续绩效提升。
AI.research_question: AI集成在组织中引发哪些核心矛盾？组织如何有效管理这些矛盾以实现可持续绩效？
AI.motivation: AI正在快速改变组织决策、劳动力结构和运营流程，但其实施引入了挑战传统管理模式的根本性矛盾。需要理解这些矛盾及其对组织的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织矛盾理论、人机协作理论、AI治理理论、组织转型理论
AI.method: 概念框架开发，结合行业案例研究、监管发展和组织研究的实证证据
AI.findings: 识别了AI集成引发的九个核心组织矛盾：自主性与人类监督、效率与信任、偏见缓解与偏见放大、工作替代与工作增强、创新速度与治理稳定性等。AI是一种组织强制函数，重塑工作的认知和结构架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"AI原生组织"概念，定义为围绕AI作为人类判断放大器而非人类能力替代品进行结构性重新设计的组织。为理解AI实施的矛盾效应提供了结构化模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了管理AI矛盾的具体指导：需要重新设计工作流程、治理系统和领导角色，围绕人机协作进行组织转型，而不是将AI视为即插即用的效率工具。

detail.abstract: From the establishment of Ahmad Shah Durrani's government in Kandahar, Afghanistan had become a completely independent country in the region. For this reason, the first rulers of this country come to power and acted as king, which resulted in the domination of foreign countries, especially England, in Afghanistan some of the king or ruler, like Shah Zaman Durrani, was very interested in conquering the northern and northwestern regions of India. On this issue, in the early year of 1797, Shah Zaman sent a message to Marquis Wesley, the Governor General of the East India Company, informing him of his decision to conquer the northern parts of India and inviting him to help push the Maratha tribe back to the Deccan and cooperate with Afghan forces. Finally, these actions imposed a series of agreements on Afghanistan that are still in place today. During the first period of Shah Shuja's reign, 1804-1809, the first treaty that was imposed, called the Peshawar Treaty, was signed by the representatives of Afghanistan and England, Alfinstin from England, Muhammad Akram, Amin Mulk, and Abul Hasan, the treasurer of Shah Shuja, on June 17, 1809, in Peshawar. The British signed three treaties with Shah Shuja. The Treaty of Peshawar, Treaty of Lahore, and Treaty of Kandahar, in all three of these treaties Shah Shuja was in different conditions. The colonialist actions of the British caused a lot of opposition from the people and governments of Afghanistan, and among all the colonial powers of that time, the European country was the first country that paid special attention to Afghanistan and its foreign policy and was still earlier than others in its internal affairs. Interfered, Britain was controlled by the East India Company from India, the said company had been able to develop its political, military, and economic influence in the land of India until the end of the 18th century. One of the most important reasons for the three wars between the two countries was the policy of development and advancement of Britain and protecting India from powers like Russia and France, and also the competition between the two empires of Russia and England in Central Asia, which led to British aggression in the territory of Afghanistan and Taking many parts of these lands was imposed by signing treaties and contracts.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了阿富汗从杜兰尼王朝建立到19世纪初期的历史，重点研究了英国通过东印度公司对阿富汗的殖民干涉，以及双方签订的多项条约（如《白沙瓦条约》、《拉合尔条约》、《坎大哈条约》）对阿富汗主权的影响。
AI.research_question: 英国东印度公司如何通过条约体系在19世纪初期逐步渗透和控制阿富汗，以及这些殖民行为对阿富汗主权和地区政治格局产生了什么影响？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解阿富汗从杜兰尼王朝建立独立国家后，如何在外交和军事压力下逐渐丧失主权，特别是英国殖民势力通过条约体系对阿富汗内政外交的干涉，这对理解当代阿富汗地缘政治格局的形成具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于殖民主义理论、地缘政治竞争理论（特别是英俄在中亚的"大博弈"），以及条约体系对国家主权侵蚀的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用历史文献分析法，基于历史档案、条约文本和外交记录，分析阿富汗与英国东印度公司之间的外交互动和条约签订过程。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）英国通过《白沙瓦条约》（1809年）等三个条约逐步确立了对阿富汗的影响力；2）这些条约是在阿富汗统治者（如沙·舒贾）不同政治处境下被迫签订的；3）英国干涉的主要动机是保护印度殖民地免受俄国和法国威胁；4）殖民行为引发了阿富汗民众和政府的强烈反对。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）丰富了殖民条约体系对主权国家影响的研究；2）提供了英俄在中亚竞争的具体案例；3）揭示了早期殖民公司（东印度公司）如何作为国家代理实施外交政策。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）帮助理解当代阿富汗与外部大国关系的根源；2）为研究殖民遗产对现代国家建设的影响提供历史视角；3）对理解中亚地区安全格局的历史演变有参考价值。

detail.title: "From 4G to 5G: Technological Evolution and Performance Improvements"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: The unpredictable emergence of smartphones, applications, online and digital devices has pushed organizations and individuals into the need to have faster, reliable and efficient wireless networks. The Fourth Generation (4G) networks could provisionally meet these demands of online communication, video streaming and mobile internet but 4G is no longer adequate as the number of connected devices and the need of high-speed data is growing and this can be defeated by Fifth Generation (5G) mobile technology. The HD-films can be downloaded immediately (within a few seconds) because of the increased internet rates of 5G large files such as movies. It is characterized by very low latency time between the receiver and the sender because of data transmission. This is essential in applications such as internet gaming, driverless vehicles and remote surgery which demand real time communication.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了从4G到5G移动技术的演进，分析了5G技术如何满足日益增长的连接设备数量和高速度数据需求，特别是在低延迟、高带宽应用方面的优势。
AI.research_question: 5G移动技术相比4G在哪些关键性能指标上有显著提升，这些提升如何满足新兴应用场景（如高清视频流、自动驾驶、远程手术等）的需求？
AI.motivation: 智能手机、应用程序和数字设备的快速发展使组织和个人对更快、更可靠、更高效的无线网络需求日益增长。4G网络已无法满足连接设备数量激增和高速度数据需求，需要新一代移动技术来解决这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动通信技术演进理论、无线网络性能评估框架、延迟敏感应用需求分析、高带宽应用场景理论。
AI.method: 技术对比分析（4G vs 5G）、性能指标评估、应用场景需求分析、文献综述。
AI.findings: 5G相比4G在下载速度、延迟时间、连接密度等方面有显著提升：高清电影可在几秒内下载；延迟极低，适合实时通信应用；能够支持更多连接设备；特别适用于互联网游戏、自动驾驶车辆和远程手术等对实时性要求高的场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了5G技术性能优势的理论框架，明确了低延迟、高带宽、高连接密度等关键指标对新兴应用场景的重要性，为移动通信技术演进提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和个人选择移动网络技术提供决策依据；为应用开发者设计5G优化应用提供指导；为网络运营商规划5G网络部署提供参考；推动自动驾驶、远程医疗等创新应用的发展。

title: Contingent Enforcement and the Endogenous Limits of Firm Scale

detail.title: Contingent Enforcement and the Endogenous Limits of Firm Scale
detail.abstract: This paper develops a firm-level framework showing how contingent enforcement constrains firm scale and shapes organizational form. In many institutional environments, legal rules exist, but enforcement is episodic rather than continuously binding. Standard models explain regulatory risk through detection probability or output-proportional penalties. This paper instead identifies a distinct structural channel: the conditional cost imposed when enforcement is activated. As firms expand, fixed commitments, organizational coupling, and reduced reversibility may cause regulatory intervention to affect a larger share of productive activity. When enforcement exposure rises faster than buffering capacity, the marginal conditional enforcement cost increases with scale. Even if enforcement probability remains constant, this mechanism endogenously limits firm growth. The model formalizes this trade-off and derives implications for organizational segmentation, firm size distributions, and cross-jurisdictional variation under contingent enforcement. By isolating scale-dependent conditional disruption-distinct from detection-based models-the paper advances institutional and development economics and lays the groundwork for empirical analysis of firm behavior under episodic enforcement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个企业层面的框架，展示或有执法如何限制企业规模并塑造组织形式。在制度环境不完善的情况下，法律规则存在但执法是偶发性的而非持续约束。研究发现，随着企业扩张，执法干预会影响更大比例的生产活动，导致边际或有执法成本随规模增加，从而内生地限制企业增长。
AI.research_question: 或有执法如何通过结构性渠道限制企业规模并影响组织形式？
AI.motivation: 在许多制度环境中，法律规则存在但执法是偶发性的而非持续约束。现有标准模型通过检测概率或与产出成比例的惩罚来解释监管风险，但本文识别了一个不同的结构性渠道：执法被激活时施加的条件成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 或有执法理论、企业规模限制理论、组织经济学、制度经济学。本文区分了基于检测的监管风险模型和基于条件破坏的规模依赖或有执法成本模型。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建企业层面的分析框架，形式化企业规模与或有执法成本之间的权衡关系。
AI.findings: 随着企业扩张，固定承诺、组织耦合和可逆性降低可能导致执法干预影响更大比例的生产活动。当执法暴露增长快于缓冲能力时，边际或有执法成本随规模增加。即使执法概率保持不变，这种机制也会内生地限制企业增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了或有执法的结构性渠道；2) 区分了基于检测的模型和基于条件破坏的模型；3) 形式化了规模依赖的或有执法成本机制；4) 推进了制度经济学和发展经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 解释了企业规模分布；2) 指导组织分割策略；3) 分析跨司法管辖区的差异；4) 为实证研究企业行为提供理论基础。

detail.abstract: The Third war between Anglo-Afghan started on 6th May 1919 and finally ended with an armistice on 8 August 1919. While it was essentially the minority of tactical victory for the British in so much as they were able to repel the regular Afghan forces, but in many ways, it was a strategic victory for the Afghanistan and Shah Amanullah khan. In fact, the beginning of the 20th century is the beginning of the strengthening of the reformist spirit of the governments. Influenced by the libertarian revolutions of the countries of the region, the intellectuals formed rescue groups against the intervention and colonial aggressions and tried to collect the secrets of the rulers in the affairs of the country. The first and second constitutionalists and the zealous youth of Afghanistan rose for the welfare of all from social justice to the formation of a non-authoritarian government. Even they sacrificed their lives for the purpose of realizing all this and were torn apart by the oppressors. They shed blood, sacrificed and left, but the history of the country never forgot them.

AI.tldr: 第三次英阿战争（1919年5月6日-8月8日）虽然在战术上是英国的胜利，但在战略上是阿富汗和阿曼努拉汗的胜利，标志着20世纪阿富汗改革精神和反殖民运动的兴起。
AI.research_question: 第三次英阿战争如何成为阿富汗的战略胜利，以及这场战争如何推动了20世纪阿富汗的改革精神和反殖民运动？
AI.motivation: 探讨第三次英阿战争在阿富汗历史上的重要意义，分析这场战争如何从战术失败转变为战略胜利，并研究其对阿富汗改革运动、反殖民斗争和国家认同形成的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略胜利与战术胜利的辩证关系；殖民与反殖民斗争理论；民族主义与国家认同形成理论；改革主义与社会变革理论。
AI.method: 历史分析方法，基于历史文献和事件分析，采用比较研究和辩证分析的方法，考察战争结果的多维度影响。
AI.findings:
1. 第三次英阿战争虽然在战术上是英国的胜利，但在战略上是阿富汗的胜利
2. 战争标志着阿富汗改革精神的兴起和反殖民意识的觉醒
3. 知识分子和改革者开始组织起来反对殖民干预
4. 宪政主义者和青年活动家为建立非专制政府和社会正义而奋斗
5. 这些运动为阿富汗的现代化和独立奠定了基础
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"战术失败但战略胜利"的战争结果分析框架
2. 丰富了殖民与反殖民斗争理论中关于小国对抗大国的战略研究
3. 深化了改革主义运动在殖民背景下的发展机制理解
4. 为民族国家形成过程中的战争作用提供了新的视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解阿富汗现代历史提供了重要视角
2. 为研究小国对抗殖民大国的战略选择提供历史借鉴
3. 为当代阿富汗政治和社会发展提供了历史根源分析
4. 为教育改革和历史教育提供了重要案例材料

detail.abstract: After the end of the First World War, Amanullah Khan came to power with the contribution of the Afghan people and Reza Shah with the help of the British in the two countries of Afghanistan and Iran with a short distance from each other. Each of these kings in the early years of their reigns, trying to stabilize their position, preferred to postpone dealing with their fundamental differences in the borders, which were a legacy of the past, to another time and have good relations with each other. In this way, Amanullah Khan was a guest of Reza Shah on his return from his European trip and visited many cultural institutions and people of Iran, but due to his proximity to Turkey, Reza Shah meet him not closely when Amanullah Khan arrived in Kabul, his idea become change with Reza Shah that he was upset with Iran's government because of this, it caused the decline of Iran-Afghanistan political relations, also on the other hand Afghanistan and Iran are two countries with a common history in the period of Amanullah Khan (1919-1929 AD) had many fields to promote and expand of relations. There were still great global powers that always tried to prevent the expansion of political, economic, and cultural relations between the two countries, but the interest and desire of the two nations of Afghanistan and Iran led to the continuation and expansion of special cultural relations with the preservation and spread of the Persian language and literature. Despite many ups and downs of relations between the two countries, cultural relations have always been the area relied upon to improve the relations between the two neighboring countries. Because cultural relations have been expanded at this level, these relations have always been the basis and foundation for the expansion of relations for other sectors, or even the replacement of political relations, which have been the focus of attention.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了第一次世界大战后阿富汗与伊朗在阿马努拉汗时期（1919-1929年）的双边关系，特别关注政治关系起伏与文化关系的持续性，探讨了外部大国干预、领导人个人因素对两国关系的影响。
AI.research_question: 在阿马努拉汗统治时期（1919-1929年），阿富汗与伊朗的政治关系为何起伏不定，而文化关系却能持续发展并成为两国关系的基础？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解两个具有共同历史、语言和文化背景的邻国，在面临外部大国干预和内部政治变化时，如何维持和发展双边关系，特别是文化关系在政治关系波动中的稳定作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文可能运用国际关系理论中的现实主义（大国干预）、建构主义（共同文化认同）和领导人个人因素理论，分析国家间关系的多层次互动。
AI.method: 采用历史分析方法，基于历史文献、档案资料和外交记录，对第一次世界大战后阿富汗与伊朗关系的演变进行案例研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）阿马努拉汗与礼萨汗早期因稳定国内局势而搁置边界争议，保持友好关系；2）阿马努拉汗亲近土耳其导致礼萨汗疏远，政治关系恶化；3）外部大国（特别是英国）试图阻止两国关系发展；4）尽管政治关系起伏，文化关系（特别是波斯语言文学）持续发展并成为两国关系的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）验证了文化关系在国家间政治关系波动中的稳定器作用；2）揭示了领导人个人因素和外交倾向对国家关系的直接影响；3）补充了关于共同文化认同在邻国关系中的建构作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为当代阿富汗-伊朗关系提供历史借鉴；2）强调文化外交在改善邻国关系中的重要性；3）提醒政策制定者关注领导人个人因素对外交关系的影响；4）为具有共同文化遗产的国家如何维护双边关系提供参考。
